note: Two layers. 'studies': one concise line per cited PMID, curated from the site's existing verified text (critique bottom lines, LRT matrix rows, systemic matrix evidence, high-risk study results, outcome cards); used for study labels and design. 'options': per treatment option (key = page slug + hash of the option's visible statement), the numerical results that the option's own text reports and attributes to a named cited study, restated in LRT style. Only these option rows display numbers under an option; a shared citation alone never brings a number into an option. 'reference_groups' and 'reference_links': explicit, reviewed presentation of source-study evidence from the HCC treatment references (liver-directed reference, systemic matrix, HCC roadmap text and critique records) for the linked modality or regimen, with the studied population, treatment arms and endpoint/horizon; every number is guarded against that study's verified site text or an exact quoted passage. Not an eligibility rule and not a regrading.

1309988.label: Bismuth-Corlette
1309988.result: Type-driven operation: I local excision; II add caudate; III hepatectomy; IV consider LT; margin clearance, not nodes, drove outcome
1309988.caution: 23 resections over thirty years; no comparison group or statistical test

1738990.label: Jones 1992
1738990.result: 17% of outpatient contrast CTs showed a hepatic lesion ≤15 mm; roughly half probably benign even with known cancer
1738990.caution: Cancer-heavy tertiary centre, 1989–90; not an incidental population

2571019.label: Spigelman 1989
2571019.result: Duodenal/periampullary adenomas near-universal in FAP, concentrated on the papilla; introduced the Spigelman stage
2571019.caution: Score built by expert judgement, never validated; omits the ampulla

3950039.label: Karhunen 1986
3950039.result: Half of men aged 35-69 had a benign hepatic lesion at autopsy, almost all mm-scale bile duct microhamartomas or small haemangiomas
3950039.caution: Targeted autopsy pathology; no prevalence for radiologically detected masses

8594428.label: Milan criteria
8594428.result: LT for single HCC ≤5 cm or up to three nodules ≤3 cm: four-year survival 75%, recurrence-free survival 83%
8594428.caution: Limits derived and applied in same 48 patients; only four recurrences; no external cohort

9885589.label: Schwartz 1999
9885589.result: Reported sub-centimetre hepatic lesions in cancer patients metastatic in 11.6% (up to 19.8% if indeterminates counted malignant)
9885589.caution: Single tertiary centre; no histological verification; known-cancer patients only

10493478.label: Fong CRS
10493478.result: CRLM resection: 5-y OS 37%, 10-y OS 22%, operative mortality 2.8%; five preoperative factors separate 5-y OS from 60% to 14%
10493478.caution: Score derived and assessed in the same 1001 patients; not validated

10615075.label: Kemeny adjuvant HAI
10615075.result: 2-y hepatic PFS 90 vs 60% HAI FUDR + systemic FU vs systemic FU; liver recurrence 7/74 vs 30/82; OS NS by KM (p=0.21)
10615075.caution: Only 26% received more than half the planned floxuridine; survival claim is a landmark

11932907.label: Jarnagin 2002
11932907.result: Resected cHCC-CC: roughly 24% 5-y survival in a non-cirrhotic Western surgical population; retrospective

15131794.label: Cooperative cyst study
15131794.result: Cyst fluid CEA 192 ng/mL: ~80% accuracy for mucinous vs non-mucinous cysts, better than EUS morphology or cytology
15131794.caution: Threshold derived and tested in same 112-patient subset; not shown to identify HGD/cancer

15997444.label: Jones 2005 CRLM biopsy
15997444.result: Biopsy before referral: needle-track deposits in 19% and 4-y survival 14% lower than unbiopsied; benign disease resected in 1.2%
15997444.caution: Association only; biopsied had 61% vs 26% synchronous disease

16111953.label: Harewood 2005
16111953.result: Pancreatitis after snare ampullectomy 33% vs 0%, favouring prophylactic pancreatic stenting; stopped early at interim look
16111953.caution: Only 19 patients; lost significance on intention-to-treat analysis

16111956.label: Pooled fluid analysis
16111956.result: Specificity 95–98% for amylase <250 U/L, CEA <5 or >800 ng/mL, CA19-9 <37 U/mL (sensitivity 19–50%); cytology sensitivity for malignancy 48%
16111956.caution: IPMN excluded; cutoffs fitted to the data that report them

16134179.label: Gupta embolisation
16134179.result: Response: carcinoid 81 vs 44% favouring bland embolisation; islet cell 50 vs 25% favouring chemoembolisation; no carcinoid PFS/OS difference
16134179.caution: Physician-chosen allocation, so not a treatment effect

16135931.label: Rea 2005
16135931.result: 5-y survival 82% after neoadjuvant chemoradiation + LT vs 21% after resection; 58% vs about 21% from start of treatment
16135931.caution: Groups not comparable: LT patients unresectable, node-negative; 33 of 71 never transplanted

16327281.label: Sendai 2006
16327281.result: Consensus: defined main- vs branch-duct IPMN and ovarian-type stroma for MCN; introduced the Sendai resection thresholds
16327281.caution: No cohort; malignancy rates from small resected series; no natural-history data

16432361.label: Triponez 2006
16432361.result: MEN1 NF-pNET: metastasis 4% below 10 mm vs 43% above 30 mm; 34% penetrance by age 50; life expectancy cut about nine years
16432361.caution: 20 mm threshold rests on single-digit events, imaging-defined metastasis, 4 y follow-up

16496320.label: Zucman-Rossi 2006
16496320.result: HCA comprises at least four genotype-phenotype groups with different malignancy association; size did not predict haemorrhage in HNF1A subtype
16496320.caution: Resection series of large tumours with no follow-up

16505413.label: CALGB 9481
16505413.result: HAI floxuridine vs bolus fluorouracil/leucovorin: OS 24.4 vs 20.0 mo, p=0.0034; hepatic response 47% vs 24%
16505413.caution: Superseded 1996 comparator; biliary injury in a third

16926567.label: Norton 2006
16926567.result: Gastrinoma exploration vs no surgery: 15-y disease-related survival 98% vs 74%; far fewer liver metastases
16926567.caution: Non-randomised, 35 self-selected controls; no bearing on non-functioning PanNET

17629995.label: Mazzaglia RFA
17629995.result: Laparoscopic RFA of NET liver metastases: morbidity 5%, no deaths; symptom relief in 94% of symptomatic (median 11 mo); LTP 6.3%; median OS 3.9 y post-RFA
17629995.caution: 80% of imaged patients developed new or progressive liver disease; grade not reported

18008357.label: Livraghi
18008357.result: RFA for single HCC ≤2 cm: sustained complete response 97.2%, no mortality, major complications 1.8%; cohort 5-y OS 55%
18008357.caution: 68% 5-y OS only in retrospectively defined operable subgroup; no control

18063061.label: Blansfield 2007
18063061.result: PNET in 17% of VHL; 8.3% metastasised; size ≥3 cm, exon 3 mutation and doubling time <500 days identified every metastatic case
18063061.caution: Rule derived and tested on the same 9 events

18358928.label: EORTC 40983
18358928.result: Perioperative FOLFOX4 vs surgery alone: three-year PFS +7.3 points, HR 0.79, p=0.058 (NS as randomised); significant only in eligible/resected
18358928.caution: No survival benefit at 8.5 years in later report; complications 16% to 25%

18376195.label: Bilimoria 2008
18376195.result: After PNET resection, age, grade and distant metastasis dominate survival; no independent effect of size, nodal status or margins
18376195.caution: Grade missing in over 40%; score discriminates only marginally better than chance

18525307.label: Kennedy Y-90
18525307.result: Single-arm: objective response 63% (per treatment), median OS 70 mo; no radiation-induced liver disease
18525307.caution: Non-standardised imaging; 78% still alive at median 42-mo follow-up

18669577.label: HCC seeding meta-analysis
18669577.result: Needle-track seeding after HCC biopsy 2.7% (1.8–4.0%), 0.9% per patient-year; no demonstrable effect on survival
18669577.caution: Seven of eight studies retrospective; follow-up shorter than time to seeding in several

19130136.label: Deneve 2009
19130136.result: Rupture in 31 (25%); size threshold fitted at 7 cm; authors advised resection above 4 cm
19130136.caution: '<5 cm never ruptures' came from a cohort that excluded small adenomas

19243014.label: AASLD liver biopsy
19243014.result: Severe bleeding ~1 in 2500 to 1 in 10,000 and death ~1 in 10,000 percutaneous biopsies; seeding ~0.13%; 2-4 h observation suffices
19243014.caution: Harm figures from diffuse-disease biopsy, not focal masses; mostly Class I Level C

19255321.label: Rusthoven SBRT
19255321.result: 60 Gy in three fractions: local control 95% at one year, 92% at two (100% if ≤3 cm); median PFS 6.1 mo; no comparator
19255321.caution: Only 15 of 47 colorectal; local control scored only in patients living six months

19470932.label: Kemeny HAI conversion
19470932.result: No control arm: HAI + systemic chemo response 92%, 47% converted to resection; median OS 39.8 mo from pump placement
19470932.caution: Only 39% reached R0; median DFS after R0 resection 7.6 mo

19664629.label: Dokmak 2009
19664629.result: Adenoma size gradient for haemorrhage and malignancy in a resect-all surgical series; origin of the resect-all-men rule
19664629.caution: Per-lesion analysis; small-lesion denominator made up of incidental microadenomas

19704057.label: PROMID
19704057.result: Octreotide vs placebo: median TTP 14.3 vs 6.0 mo, HR about 0.33; stabilisation, no survival or QoL benefit shown
19704057.caution: Interim analysis; 85 of planned 162 randomised; only 16 deaths

19723142.label: Campbell 1 mm rule
19723142.result: Survival equivocal R1 15.4 vs unequivocal R1 12.6 vs R0 25.4 mo; 1 mm rule raised R1 rate from 44% to 79%
19723142.caution: Key comparison non-significant; margin status lost after multivariable adjustment

19908093.label: PRECISION V
19908093.result: DEB-TACE vs conventional TACE: EASL objective response at 6 mo not significantly different — primary endpoint failed
19908093.caution: No TTP/survival data; fixed 150 mg doxorubicin vs adjusted dose; manufacturer-sponsored

19931502.label: WHO-IWGE echinococcosis
19931502.result: Consensus: PAIR + albendazole for active CE1/CE3a cysts >5 cm; benzimidazole alone for small cysts; watch-and-wait for inactive CE4/CE5
19931502.caution: Ten of eleven graded recommendations at Strength B / Quality III

20071702.label: Preoperative drainage RCT
20071702.result: Routine preoperative biliary drainage vs early surgery: serious complications 74 vs 39%; no reduction in surgical complications or mortality
20071702.caution: Plastic stents only; bilirubin capped at 250 micromol/L; no neoadjuvant therapy

20375404.label: ABC-02
20375404.result: Median OS 11.7 vs 8.1 mo, cisplatin–gemcitabine vs gemcitabine; HR 0.64 (0.52–0.80); no added overall toxicity
20375404.caution: iCCA only 80 of 410, no site-specific estimate; median follow-up 8.2 mo

20567019.label: Hendlisz Y90
20567019.result: Y90 + fluorouracil vs fluorouracil: time to liver progression 5.5 vs 2.1 mo, HR 0.38; no OS benefit shown (HR 0.92)
20567019.caution: Stopped at 46 of 58 planned; 10 controls crossed over to radioembolization

20829538.label: CRLM imaging meta-analysis
20829538.result: MRI, CT and FDG PET detect 74–81% of colorectal liver metastases per lesion; MRI better than CT only below 10 mm
20829538.caution: Staging populations; says nothing about low-prevalence incidental lesions

20887318.label: Stoot 2010
20887318.result: Crude malignant transformation 4.2%; '4.4% occurred below 5 cm'; authors call the 5 cm rule 'open for debate'
20887318.caution: Crude aggregates of 174 unappraised publications; inconsistent denominators

20889105.label: ACR CT white paper 2010
20889105.result: Consensus: three-tier liver incidental-lesion risk stratification using 0.5 cm, 1.5 cm, 20 HU and 6-month thresholds
20889105.caution: Thresholds not empirically derived; meets no formal national standard

21094555.label: Noels 2011 pregnancy
21094555.result: 17 pregnancies in 12 women with HCA: growth in four, no rupture; wait-and-see reasonable for small adenomas; prospective series
21094555.caution: Lesions over 5 cm treated beforehand; cannot establish safety

21134563.label: Akyildiz RFA
21134563.result: Laparoscopic RFA: morbidity 5.6%, ≥partial symptom relief 97%, per-lesion local control 92%; median OS 6 y, five-year OS 57% (single-arm)
21134563.caution: Selected <20% liver volume, ≤15 lesions; grade/Ki-67 not examined

21148580.label: Farges 2011
21148580.result: Adenoma malignant transformation overwhelmingly male (47% vs 4%); associated with beta-catenin activation and large size
21148580.caution: Tertiary surgical series; small male denominator

21306237.label: Sunitinib A6181111
21306237.result: Sunitinib vs placebo in progressive PanNET: median PFS 11.4 vs 5.5 mo; HR 0.42; response rate 9.3%
21306237.caution: Stopped early at 81 of 260 planned events; unblinded investigator assessment

21306238.label: RADIANT-3
21306238.result: Everolimus vs placebo: median PFS 11.0 vs 4.6 mo, HR 0.35; partial response 5%, none complete
21306238.caution: 73% placebo crossover; OS HR 1.05 cannot show survival effect

21425151.label: Kiefer TACE 2-centre
21425151.result: cTACE: major complications after 5 of 165 procedures, no 30-day disease-specific mortality; median survival 20 mo from diagnosis
21425151.caution: No control arm; 40% adenocarcinoma of unknown primary

21480324.label: Ronot 2011
21480324.result: MRI and biopsy each assigned HCA subtype correctly ~80% of the time; accuracy held in lesions <5 cm

21492336.label: Heimbach 2011
21492336.result: Peritoneal metastases at staging: 5/6 after positive transperitoneal FNA vs 14/175 (8%) without FNA; retrospective
21492336.caution: Exposed group 6 patients, 5 events; unmatched; reverse causation not excluded

21561347.label: PRODIGE 4 / ACCORD 11
21561347.result: FOLFIRINOX vs gemcitabine, metastatic PDAC: median OS 11.1 vs 6.8 mo, HR 0.57; QoL deterioration delayed despite more toxicity
21561347.caution: Only age <76, ECOG 0-1, no cardiac disease, near-normal bilirubin

21616431.label: van Vledder 2011 RFA
21616431.result: RFA of hepatocellular adenoma: primary efficacy 57.8% overall, 31% percutaneously; two major complications
21616431.caution: Feasibility only; no tissue to confirm diagnosis

22493375.label: DEBIRI
22493375.result: DEBIRI vs FOLFIRI: median OS 22 vs 15 mo; hepatic response 68.6 vs 20%
22493375.caution: Two centres, open label; obsolete, time-capped comparator; not reproduced

22504095.label: 12-centre protocol series
22504095.result: Neoadjuvant CRT + LT protocol: 5-y ITT OS 53% from enrolment; 5-y post-LT RFS 65%; dropout 71 (25%)
22504095.caution: 193 of 287 from one centre; no comparison with resection

22619025.label: van Aalten 2012
22619025.result: Adenoma haemorrhage in up to 27.2%; bleeding documented in lesions down to 1 cm; two thirds of bleeds were the presenting event
22619025.caution: 27.2% is a maximum from a 91% resected population

22687371.label: Fukuoka 2012
22687371.result: Consensus: high-risk stigmata/worrisome features framework; main duct threshold >5 mm; branch-duct IPMN >3 cm moved from resection to observation
22687371.caution: All recommendations level 4-5 evidence; risk tiers lack operating characteristics

22722717.label: DEB-TACE phase 2
22722717.result: DEB-TACE for NET liver metastases: 7 bilomas in 13 patients (54%), two deaths after prolonged infection; trial halted at interim safety analysis
22722717.caution: No survival or progression endpoint; RECIST objective response zero

22779737.label: Abscess cancer risk
22779737.result: Pyogenic liver abscess: cancer incidence 3.8-fold overall, 7.9 liver, 34.6 biliary tract, 5.3 colorectal; risk highest in first 90 days to a year; registry
22779737.caution: Not causal; unadjusted for 48% diabetes and 8% cirrhosis

22782416.label: ESPAC-3 periampullary
22782416.result: Adjuvant chemotherapy vs observation: OS HR 0.86, p=0.25 — primary endpoint not met; adjusted HR 0.75, p=0.03 (hypothesis generating)
22782416.caution: Ampullary subgroup not powered; only 135 of 297 ampullary tumours subtyped

22967994.label: NORDIC NEC
22967994.result: Performance status, primary site and raised platelets/LDH dominant prognostic factors; Ki-67 <55% responded less to platinum but lived longer
22967994.caution: 55% cut-off internally derived; pancreatic NEC only 71 patients

23026934.label: Adsay 2012 four subsets
23026934.result: Anatomic definition of ampullary carcinoma; four site-specific subsets differ markedly in stage and outcome
23026934.caution: Small, unadjusted, single-reader subgroups; independence from stage not shown

23887712.label: TERT promoter
23887712.result: TERT promoter mutation completes malignant transformation of beta-catenin-mutated adenomas and is the commonest somatic event in HCC
23887712.caution: Only 60 typical adenomas: confirmatory marker, not a pre-transformation tool

24104372.label: CONKO-001
24104372.result: Adjuvant gemcitabine vs observation: median DFS 13.4 vs 6.7 mo; 5-y OS 20.7 vs 10.4%
24104372.caution: Postop CA19-9 <92.5 kU/L only; median survival gain only 2.6 mo

24120480.label: EORTC 40983 long-term
24120480.result: Perioperative FOLFOX4 + surgery vs surgery alone: median OS 61.3 vs 54.3 mo; HR 0.88 (0.68–1.14), p=0.34 — no OS benefit
24120480.caution: PFS benefit significant only after excluding ineligible patients

24131140.label: MPACT
24131140.result: Nab-paclitaxel + gemcitabine vs gemcitabine, metastatic PDAC: median OS 8.5 vs 6.7 mo, HR 0.72; grade 3 neuropathy 17%

24253141.label: Hashim 2014
24253141.result: Resected locoregional PNET: nodal metastasis 38% overall and 12–13% in 1–1.5 cm tumours; no preoperative factor identified a low-risk group
24253141.caution: Operated patients only; small-tumour estimates rest on single-digit event counts

24354378.label: SAR/APA template
24354378.result: Consensus reporting template standardising pancreatic cancer resectability vocabulary, incl. 180-degree abutment/encasement rule
24354378.caution: Single 2011 expert meeting; no validation of reproducibility or outcomes

24360654.label: FISH meta-analysis
24360654.result: PSC bile duct brushings: FISH polysomy sensitivity 51%, specificity 93%; any positive FISH 68%/70%
24360654.caution: All eight studies from one centre; overlapping patients likely

24441817.label: Sapisochin 2014 Spanish cohort
24441817.result: 5-y survival 78% HCC-CC (n=15) vs 86% matched HCC (p=0.9); explant-matched, retrospective
24441817.caution: Excludes incidental, beyond-UCSF and 16 unmatchable patients (5-y survival 28%)

24646562.label: D’Angelica phase II
24646562.result: HAI + systemic chemotherapy for unresectable CRLM: response 76%, conversion to resection 47%; no comparator

24717919.label: New EPOC
24717919.result: Chemotherapy + cetuximab vs chemotherapy: median PFS 14.1 vs 20.5 mo, HR 1.48 (1.04–2.12) — harm with cetuximab
24717919.caution: Stopped for futility at 58% of planned events; OS immature

24750272.label: Weynand 2014
24750272.result: EUS-FNA Ki-67 under-grades G2 tumours in about 70%; cytological G3 reliably marks aggressive disease; reproducible between readers
24750272.caution: Only 33 resected tumours available for histological comparison

24760723.label: Bieze 2014
24760723.result: Explicit derivation of adenoma bleeding threshold gave 35 mm rather than 50 mm; retrospective
24760723.caution: 5 cm already used to select resection; half the lesions unsubtypeable

24841347.label: Gratian 2014
24841347.result: NF-PNET ≤2 cm: 29% nodal and 10% distant metastases; extent of resection and lymphadenectomy made no survival difference
24841347.caution: Registry of malignant-coded tumours; rates not transferable to incidental lesions

24937669.label: DEB vs cTACE
24937669.result: DEB vs conventional TACE: median TTP 9 mo in both arms; 2-y survival 55.4–56.8% across arms (p=0.949); stopped for futility
24937669.caution: Stopped at 83% of planned size; cannot establish equivalence

25014687.label: CLARINET
25014687.result: Lanreotide vs placebo: PFS HR 0.47 (0.30–0.73); 24-mo PFS 65.1% vs 33.0%; no OS or QoL difference
25014687.caution: Non-functioning, 96% stable at entry; placebo median PFS 18.0 mo

25212123.label: Berzigotti meta-analysis
25212123.result: CSPH vs none after HCC resection: 3-y mortality OR 2.09, 5-y OR 2.07; postoperative decompensation OR 3.04
25212123.caution: Crude unadjusted estimates from observational studies

25293823.label: Ridtitid 2014
25293823.result: EUS stages ampullary lesions about as well as ERCP; excellent for T1 but misses about a fifth of intraductal extension and deeper invasion
25293823.caution: Retrospective; partly circular reference standard; no stent in place

25356975.label: ACMG GSD I
25356975.result: Guideline: hepatic adenomas in 70-80% of adults with GSD I from mean age 14.8 y; tumour markers not useful for surveillance
25356975.caution: Adenoma recommendations are explicitly expert opinion

25456912.label: Graff-Baker debulking
25456912.result: ≥70% debulking: extent removed did not affect liver PFS (P=.74) or disease-specific survival (P=.37); 5-y disease-specific survival 90%
25456912.caution: Patients with <70% achievable excluded, so no sub-70% comparison

25783680.label: Balci 2015 nodal substaging
25783680.result: Number of metastatic nodes stratified survival, supporting an N1/N2 split; N0 vs N1 distinction largely disappears with ≥12 nodes examined; retrospective
25783680.caution: Modest effect; unadjusted for adjuvant therapy

25793719.label: Recurrence after resection
25793719.result: Recurrence 17% after IPMN resection; 45% vs 9% with vs without invasive component; non-invasive branch-duct lesions essentially never recurred as cancer
25793719.caution: Key subgroup claims rest on single-digit event counts

25805375.label: AGA 2015
25805375.result: Guideline: stop surveillance after 5 y of stability or if unfit for surgery; EUS-FNA/surgery only with two or more high-risk features
25805375.caution: Every recommendation very low quality evidence; surveillance intervals unsupported

26041666.label: Hüttner 2015
26041666.result: Enucleation vs formal pancreatectomy: less blood loss, shorter operation, less endocrine/exocrine insufficiency, but about twice the fistula rate
26041666.caution: 22 non-randomised studies; different lesions; no oncological outcome compared

26045140.label: International SCN series
26045140.result: SCN almost always benign, slow-growing, rarely symptomatic and essentially never fatal; supports conservative management
26045140.caution: 61% resected, nearly a third radiological-only diagnoses, median follow-up about 3 y

26172136.label: AHPBA 2015
26172136.result: Consensus: resect ducts with ipsilateral liver + caudate; no primary-tumour biopsy in LT candidates; PVE if remnant <30%; protocol LT if unresectable/PSC
26172136.caution: Ungraded six-member panel; drainage preference since contradicted by an RCT

26267832.label: Shady ablation margins
26267832.result: Local recurrence 90% with no margin vs 5% beyond 10 mm; median local PFS 6 vs 30 mo for tumours >3 cm vs smaller
26267832.caution: 48% of tumours progressed locally over 55 mo; margins measurable in 75% only

26417845.label: Adam 2015 consensus
26417845.result: Consensus: default sequencing for four synchronous CRLM scenarios; do not withhold resection from patients merely stable on chemotherapy
26417845.caution: Sequencing not shown to improve survival; sponsor-convened expert panel

26479271.label: Wire-guided papillectomy RCT
26479271.result: Wire-guided vs conventional: pancreatic stenting achieved 100 vs 65%; post-papillectomy pancreatitis 18 vs 13% — not reduced

26482044.label: Tang 2016
26482044.result: WD-NET with high-grade component kept WD-NET immunophenotype, DAXX/ATRX/MEN1 genotype and intermediate prognosis, unlike PD-NEC; retrospective

26503201.label: Tao dose-response
26503201.result: 3-y OS 73% with BED >80.5 Gy vs 38% below; dose the only independent predictor of local control and OS
26503201.caution: Dose confounded by era, technique and target size; only 19 high-dose patients

26516032.label: EASL vascular liver 2015
26516032.result: 60–80% of Budd-Chiari patients have multiple benign hypervascular nodules; HCC in about 4% by 5 y; cirrhosis HCC criteria do not apply
26516032.caution: Committee opinion where evidence absent; no validated biopsy trigger

26522945.label: Von Meyenburg complexes
26522945.result: Review: VMCs about 5.6% at autopsy; CT/US cannot separate them from small metastases, heavily T2-weighted MRI/MRCP usually can
26522945.caution: No quantified MRI accuracy; no absolute malignant risk (about 35 reported CCA cases)

26597365.label: Sadot 2016
26597365.result: Initial observation of small sporadic asymptomatic PanNET: no metastases over median 44 mo; single centre, retrospective
26597365.caution: A quarter crossed over to surgery; unoperated followed only 33 mo

26668346.label: Hong proton phase II
26668346.result: iCCA cohort: 2-y local control 94.1%, median OS 22.5 mo; overall grade 3 toxicity 4.8%; single-arm
26668346.caution: No iCCA efficacy hypothesis or control arm; 54% of iCCA developed distant metastases

26695839.label: Konstantinidis HAI cohort
26695839.result: Liver-confined unresectable iCCA: median OS 30.8 vs 18.4 mo, HAI + systemic vs systemic alone; non-randomised
26695839.caution: Assignment by oncologist preference; response and PFS not significantly different

26703889.label: RADIANT-4
26703889.result: Everolimus vs placebo: median PFS 11.0 vs 3.9 mo (blinded central review); response rate 2%; no mature OS
26703889.caution: 80% had ≤10% hepatic burden; says nothing on heavy liver burden

26709110.label: AGA criteria validation
26709110.result: 2015 AGA criteria missed 38% of advanced neoplasia and 45% of IPMNs with HGD/cancer; would send 43% of those selected to unnecessary surgery
26709110.caution: 13 events in 41 verified patients; no CIs; main-duct IPMN excluded

26712231.label: Sadowski 2016
26712231.result: 68Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT found far more GEP-NET lesions than 111In-pentetreotide SPECT/CT or cross-sectional imaging; often changed plan
26712231.caution: Reference standard built from the tests themselves; no outcome data

26743012.label: Crippa 2016
26743012.result: Non-operated IPMN: 5-y disease-specific survival 96.2% with worrisome features vs 60.2% with high-risk stigmata
26743012.caution: Median follow-up 51 mo; 13.5% crossed over to surgery; unfit or unwilling cohort

26776848.label: Vilchez 2016 UNOS
26776848.result: 5-y post-LT survival 40% for HCC-CC; worse than HCC and similar to cholangiocarcinoma
26776848.caution: No tumour data; recurrence known in only 16% of patients

26830608.label: Kaltenbach 2016
26830608.result: 15.1% of ultrasound exams had at least one of five benign findings, mostly fatty sparing and cysts; FNH 0.18%, adenoma 0.04%; retrospective
26830608.caution: Single centre; malignant lesions not counted; not a general-population prevalence

26903575.label: SIRFLOX
26903575.result: No PFS gain from adding SIRT to first-line FOLFOX (10.2 vs 10.7 mo, HR 0.93) and no conversion gain (resection 13.7 vs 14.2%)
26903575.caution: Hepatic PFS gain (20.5 vs 12.6 mo) only from competing-risk analysis

26919265.label: Chiche 2016 ELTR
26919265.result: LT for adenomatosis: malignant transformation in 35% of explants; three deaths within 90 days, five retransplants, three fatal recurrences
26919265.caution: Registry adenoma coding unreliable; a quarter of cases needed manual verification

27085809.label: EASL 2016
27085809.result: Guideline: lifestyle change for all HCA; resect HCA in men or with β-catenin mutation; in women resect at ≥5 cm or growth after six-month observation
27085809.caution: All recommendations evidence level II-2, II-3 or III; 5 cm and male-sex rules weak

27134017.label: Milan-NET transplant
27134017.result: Milan-NET, LT vs non-LT: 5-y OS 97.2 vs 50.9%, 10-y 88.8 vs 22.4%; propensity-adjusted RMST gain 38.4 mo at 10 y; nonrandomised
27134017.caution: Allocation by list capacity, age, refusal; LT group 15 years younger

27139057.label: LAP07
27139057.result: Consolidation chemoradiotherapy vs chemotherapy after induction: OS 15.2 vs 16.5 mo, HR 1.03 — no survival gain; erlotinib added nothing
27139057.caution: Stopped early for futility; chemotherapy regimens now obsolete

27160474.label: FOLFIRINOX in LAPC
27160474.result: Patient-level meta-analysis: median OS 24.2 mo with FOLFIRINOX in LAPC; resection in about a quarter
27160474.caution: All non-randomised studies; per-study medians range 10–33 mo

27177928.label: Rebouissou 2016
27177928.result: Malignant risk in beta-catenin-activated HCA graded by the specific CTNNB1 residue mutated; supports subtype over size stratification
27177928.caution: Routine glutamine synthetase staining identifies only a minority of mutated adenomas

27306941.label: Yachida 2017
27306941.result: FAP duodenal surveillance (median 8.5 y): no deaths from duodenal neoplasia; high-grade dysplasia only in Spigelman stage IV
27306941.caution: Rests on 4 or 5 events among 8 stage IV patients

27481548.label: Sapisochin very early iCCA
27481548.result: 5-y post-LT OS 65% very early (single ≤2 cm, n=15) vs 45% advanced (n=33); 5-y recurrence 18 vs 61%; retrospective
27481548.caution: All diagnosed on explant; does not show such patients can be identified before LT

27566258.label: Cercek HAI refractory CRLM
27566258.result: HAI for chemo-refractory liver-only CRLM: response 33%, median OS 20 mo

27575024.label: FIRE-3
27575024.result: Central review: early shrinkage 68.2 vs 49.1%, depth of response -48.9 vs -32.3% (FOLFIRI+cetuximab vs +bevacizumab); OS 8.1 mo longer
27575024.caution: Post hoc analyses; secondary resection not reported

27575820.label: PREMIERE
27575820.result: Y-90 vs cTACE: median TTP >26 vs 6.8 mo, HR 0.122; survival identical
27575820.caution: Stopped for slow accrual at a third of planned size; TTP censored at LT

27586202.label: Reid 2016 subtyping
27586202.result: Intestinal vs pancreatobiliary subtyping only fairly reproducible (kappa 0.39, full agreement 23%); 40% morphologically mixed
27586202.caution: Subtype survival difference only after forced binary assignment; not independent of stage

27693645.label: Three-guideline comparison
27693645.result: AGA rule would avoid 28% of resections but miss 12% of cysts with HGD/cancer, with 41% still unnecessary; ~half of resected cysts benign
27693645.caution: Resected patients only; 12% figure rests on two lesions

27696456.label: Njei 2016
27696456.result: PSC strictures: cholangioscopy with targeted biopsy accuracy 96% but pooled sensitivity 65% (35–87%), vs brush cytology 52%
27696456.caution: Cholangioscopy data from 4 studies, 128 patients; accuracy driven by true negatives

27824027.label: ERCP vs EUS
27824027.result: Malignant biliary stricture sensitivity: EUS-FNA 75% vs ERCP brushing/forceps biopsy 49%; specificity 100% in all studies
27824027.caution: Largely indirect: only 3 of 8 studies applied both tests; unweighted pooling

27939373.label: Nault 2017
27939373.result: Symptomatic bleeding 14%, HCC 3%; size did not predict symptomatic bleeding (P=0.29) or malignancy (P=0.053); subtype and sex did
27939373.caution: Molecular cohort; no fixed follow-up horizon

28027599.label: Jung 2017
28027599.result: LT for explant-defined 'very early' cHCC-CC: 5-y survival 93.3% (15 patients); post-recurrence survival significantly worse after LT
28027599.caution: Resection comparator restricted to most favourable tumours

28076709.label: NETTER-1
28076709.result: 177Lu-Dotatate vs octreotide LAR 60 mg: PFS HR 0.21; response 18 vs 3% (blinded central review)
28076709.caution: No OS benefit shown: interim p=0.004 missed 0.000085 boundary; final analysis negative

28129987.label: ESPAC-4
28129987.result: Adjuvant gemcitabine-capecitabine vs gemcitabine: median OS 28.0 vs 25.5 mo, HR 0.82, p=0.032; estimated 5-y OS 28.8 vs 16.3%
28129987.caution: RFS endpoint negative; benefit concentrated in R0; ampullary cancer excluded

28376151.label: EORTC 40004 (CLOCC)
28376151.result: Local treatment + systemic vs systemic alone: 8-y OS 35.9 vs 8.9%; HR 0.58 (0.38–0.88); five-year hepatic progression 62.1 vs 88.2%
28376151.caution: Not powered for survival; accrual failed at 119; almost half also resected

28426374.label: MSKCC HAI propensity
28426374.result: Perioperative HAI vs none after CRLM resection: median OS 67 vs 44 mo; propensity-adjusted HR 0.67 (0.59–0.76)
28426374.caution: Non-randomised over 21 years; benefit largest in node-negative, low-risk patients

28435454.label: NETPET derivation
28435454.result: Dual DOTATATE/FDG PET: FDG-positive, SSTR-negative group had 11-mo median survival, separated from all others; hypothesis-generating
28435454.caution: Mixed primaries, no pancreas-specific signal; no adjustment for PRRT

28518415.label: TAE systematic review
28518415.result: TAE for HCA: surgery avoided in 45% overall and 84% electively; major complications 5.3%
28518415.caution: 'Surgery avoided' is a process measure; follow-up too short to detect transformation

28580538.label: LR-M
28580538.result: Review of the imaging spectrum of biphenotypic liver tumours and why they fall into LR-M; no pooled accuracy
28580538.caution: No cohort; cannot say how often cHCC-CCA is read as HCC

28594340.label: Genc recurrence score
28594340.result: Grade 2, positive nodes and perineural invasion predict recurrence after resection of G1–2 NF-pNET; 105/107 with none stayed disease-free
28594340.caution: Internally validated only; no better than grade alone (p = 0.059)

28609356.label: NANETS 2017 medical
28609356.result: Guideline: 177Lu-DOTATATE second line after SSA progression; no consensus on treating vs observing low-volume liver metastases or embolisation type
28609356.caution: No evidence grading; predates NETTER-1 survival analysis; panellist industry ties

28609357.label: NANETS 2017 surgical
28609357.result: Consensus: small bowel NET debulking threshold lowered from 90% to 70%; cytoreduction regardless of metastasis number/size, margins or extrahepatic disease
28609357.caution: Rests on retrospective single-institution series; no systematic search, evidence grading or RCT data

28632865.label: CALGB/SWOG 80405
28632865.result: Cetuximab vs bevacizumab with chemo: median OS about 29–30 mo, no detectable difference; median OS over five years in the 12% surgically cleared
28632865.caution: Stopped for futility; CI reaches a 23% survival advantage for cetuximab

28664934.label: Avadhani 2017
28664934.result: Malignant if three or more of eleven features: sensitivity 70%, specificity 97%, accuracy 83%; general pathologists matched cytopathologists
28664934.caution: Cut point fitted in a 50:50 archival series; no perihilar or PSC cases identified

28735806.label: Fukuoka 2017
28735806.result: Consensus revision: enhancing mural nodule threshold 5 mm; CA19-9 and growth >5 mm/2 y added as worrisome features; indefinite surveillance (5-y stop rejected)
28735806.caution: No new primary evidence; no operating characteristics for revised risk tiers

28739282.label: Pergolini 2017
28739282.result: BD-IPMN: malignancy still arose after 5 and 10 y; 18.8-fold above US population even without worrisome features at 5 y
28739282.caution: Counts high-grade dysplasia vs invasive-cancer comparator; 5-y survivors only

28781171.label: FOXFIRE/SIRFLOX/FOXFIRE-Global
28781171.result: FOLFOX + SIRT vs FOLFOX: OS 22.6 vs 23.3 mo, HR 1.04 (0.90–1.19); no PFS gain; resection 17% vs 16%
28781171.caution: Right-sided benefit signal is post hoc, based on 179 patients

28857134.label: Klompenhouwer 2017
28857134.result: Large HCA regressed below 5 cm in only 8.5–15.3% by six months vs 58.5% eventually (median two years); no complications in observation; retrospective

28877981.label: SHIP population MRCP
28877981.result: Cysts in 494 of 1077 adults on MRCP (about half), increasing with age; over 5 y half showed minimal growth; population cohort
28877981.caution: No cancer events in cyst carriers; lesions mostly below guideline size

28902669.label: LIGRO
28902669.result: sFLR <30%: resection completed 92% ALPPS vs 57% portal occlusion + two-stage; ALPPS severe complications 43%, 90-day mortality 8.3%
28902669.caution: No survival endpoint; embolisation-first with ALPPS salvage reached 82% (NS vs 92%)

28927870.label: ACR liver white paper 2017
28927870.result: Consensus: two-tier risk algorithm (1 cm, 1.5 cm, 20 HU thresholds); no workup for sub-centimetre lesions in low risk or benign features, else prompt MRI
28927870.caution: Thresholds not empirically derived; committee says not standard of care

28970292.label: PancreaSeq 2018
28970292.result: Cyst-fluid NGS: 100% sensitive for IPMN, 100% specific for mucinous cyst; TP53/PIK3CA/PTEN mark advanced neoplasia
28970292.caution: Only 17% surgically verified; advanced-neoplasia rules fitted to the same 102 resected cases

29107679.label: SARAH
29107679.result: Median OS 8.0 vs 9.9 mo radioembolisation vs sorafenib, HR 1.15 — no survival advantage; better tolerability and QoL
29107679.caution: 22% of radioembolisation arm never treated; activity dosed by body surface area

29121977.label: Biliary cystadenoma series
29121977.result: All 6 resected biliary cystadenomas mistaken preoperatively for simple/hydatid cysts; recurrence in three of five followed
29121977.caution: Single-centre series; no prevalence or diagnostic accuracy data

29360137.label: Brunt 2018 consensus
29360137.result: Consensus: established the modern cHCC-CCA definition and made stem-cell subtypes obsolete; set no component threshold
29360137.caution: Pathologists later apply the definition with kappa 0.19–0.37

29405274.label: BCAT
29405274.result: Adjuvant gemcitabine vs observation after extrahepatic bile duct cancer resection: OS HR 1.01 (0.70–1.45), RFS HR 0.93 — negative
29405274.caution: iCCA ineligible; control 5-y OS 51.6% vs assumed 30%

29485131.label: ACG 2018
29485131.result: Guideline: size-stratified cyst surveillance algorithm; rejects AGA 5-y stopping rule if surgically fit; reconsider surveillance at age 75
29485131.caution: All 20 recommendations low/very low quality; intervals and age limits not evidence-based

29498924.label: SIRveNIB
29498924.result: Y-90 radioembolisation vs sorafenib: ITT median OS 8.8 vs 10.0 mo, no difference; fewer adverse events and higher response with Y-90
29498924.caution: 28.6% assigned Y-90 never received it vs 9.0% for sorafenib

29503247.label: MWA vs RFA
29503247.result: 2-y LTP 6 vs 12% (per lesion) MWA vs RFA; RR 1.62 (0.66–3.94), p=0.27 — superiority not shown; no survival difference
29503247.caution: Powered for an implausibly large difference; null result does not show equivalence

29543938.label: TACE + EBRT
29543938.result: TACE + EBRT vs sorafenib for portal vein invasion: 12-week PFS 86.7 vs 34.3% (primary); median OS 55.0 vs 43.0 weeks
29543938.caution: 90.7% of sorafenib arm crossed over within 24 weeks; unblinded surrogate endpoint

29548617.label: Lunsford protocol series
29548617.result: LT for unresectable iCCA stable on chemotherapy: 5-y OS 83.3% (CI 27.3–97.5); three of six recurred; no comparator
29548617.caution: Six of 21 referrals transplanted; no intention-to-treat denominator

29572896.label: ASS1 / sonic hedgehog
29572896.result: ASS1 overexpression reflects sonic hedgehog activation, not a separate class; ASS1 IHC neither specific nor associated with haemorrhage

29574408.label: European 2018
29574408.result: Guideline: conservative management below 40 mm; resect if main duct >5 mm; lifelong follow-up while fit for surgery
29574408.caution: Most statements GRADE 2C; malignancy thresholds from retrospective resected series

29724520.label: Y-90 late toxicity
29724520.result: Grade 3 serologic toxicity 4 of 52, no liver failure; cirrhosis-like/portal hypertension imaging 29% at 1 y; baseline ascites median OS 7.3 mo
29724520.caution: Survivor-selected denominator (52 at 1 y, 11 at 4 y); no dosimetry

29755017.label: Attila 2018
29755017.result: Endoscopic papillectomy: complete resection about 90%, no mortality; adenocarcinoma in a third of presumed-benign specimens
29755017.caution: 44 patients, 24-mo median follow-up; recurrence risk not definable

29922827.label: Hu 2018 germline
29922827.result: Deleterious germline mutations in six genes in 5.5% of unselected pancreatic cancer, regardless of family history
29922827.caution: Penetrance and survival effect not established; most genes not actionable

30016989.label: RETNET protocol
30016989.result: Protocol only, no outcomes: RCT of bland vs lipiodol vs drug-eluting-bead embolisation, 60 per arm; primary endpoint hepatic PFS
30016989.caution: Powered on 11 vs 20 mo retrospective single-centre estimates

30025198.label: Gevers 2018 bariatric
30025198.result: Adenoma regressed after bariatric weight loss in all 3 cases, completely in two
30025198.caution: Too small and selectively reported to replace resection

30054622.label: Singh 2018 follow-up
30054622.result: RAND/UCLA consensus: lighter follow-up early after GEP-NET resection, surveillance beyond 10 y; none for grade 1 node-negative pNET <2 cm
30054622.caution: No-follow-up exemption is expert opinion; cohort 10-year recurrence 48.5%

30054698.label: Antwi 2018 GLP-1R PET
30054698.result: 68Ga-DOTA-exendin-4 PET/CT localised occult insulinoma more accurately and reproducibly than exendin SPECT/CT or 3T MRI; prospective
30054698.caution: Accuracy only in 38 of 52 who reached surgery; no specificity data

30122355.label: DRAINAGE
30122355.result: Endoscopic vs percutaneous drainage: severe drainage-related complications 67% vs 63%; RR 0.94 (0.64–1.40) — primary endpoint negative
30122355.caution: Stopped at 54 of 106 on a mortality signal; 56% crossover to percutaneous

30251931.label: LI-RADS v2018
30251931.result: LI-RADS applies only to patients at risk for HCC; major-feature agreement 0.84–0.87 but category agreement kappa 0.22–0.79
30251931.caution: Narrative self-description by system authors; no accuracy data of its own

30323089.label: Trikalinos 2018
30323089.result: Gemcitabine-platinum disease control 78.4% vs 38.5%, but OS null: 11.5 vs 11.7 mo (p=0.9686)
30323089.caution: Regimen preference rests on disease control, not survival

30442549.label: Li 2018 meta-analysis
30442549.result: Numerically better survival and recurrence after LT than hepatectomy, null in comparative studies; authors still recommend hepatectomy

30445016.label: LI-RADS accuracy review
30445016.result: HCC proportion rises from 13% at LR-2 to 94% at LR-5; LR-M 93% malignant but only 36% HCC
30445016.caution: High-risk population only; LR-2 estimate provisional, high risk of bias

30552477.label: Lee 2019 LR-M features
30552477.result: LR-M features also in half of HCC; even a three-feature rule misses 45% of cHCC-CCA, so MRI cannot reliably exclude it

30575490.label: PRODIGE-24
30575490.result: Adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX vs gemcitabine (resected PDAC): median DFS 21.6 vs 12.8 mo; median OS gain 19.4 mo; grade 3–4 toxicity 76%
30575490.caution: Selected fit population (<80 y, CA19-9 <180 U/mL); ampullary cancer excluded

30690729.label: Joseph 2019 genomics
30690729.result: Clonal common origin with TERT promoter mutation founding both components; cHCC-CCA genomics resemble HCC rather than iCCA
30690729.caution: 20 tumours; underpowered to exclude targetable iCCA drivers

30707660.label: PRODIGE-12
30707660.result: Adjuvant GEMOX vs surveillance: RFS HR 0.88 (0.62–1.25) — negative; no QoL benefit; OS numerically favoured surveillance
30707660.caution: Powered for HR 0.60 in a low-risk population; iCCA subgroup inconclusive

30798397.label: Ludwig 2019 LI-RADS v2018
30798397.result: cHCC-CCA is the dominant source of false-positive LR-5; LR-M/LR-TIV flagged 62-71% of cHCC-CCA vs about 90% of iCCA

30843343.label: Cillo 2019
30843343.result: Review: resection gives about 30% 5-y survival in perihilar/iCCA; avoid preoperative biopsy; complete imaging before biliary drainage
30843343.caution: Narrative, no search strategy; survival from uncontrolled surgical series

30876788.label: Chi 2019
30876788.result: Resected cHCC-CCA mostly atypical for HCC on imaging; recurrence profile resembles CCA; OS between HCC and iCCA

30922733.label: BILCAP
30922733.result: ITT median OS 51.1 vs 36.4 mo with capecitabine; HR 0.81 (0.63–1.04), p=0.097 — primary endpoint not met
30922733.caution: 19% iCCA, no site-specific estimate; significance only in sensitivity/per-protocol

30953467.label: PUMP (protocol)
30953467.result: Protocol only: RCT of adjuvant hepatic arterial floxuridine vs resection alone in low-risk CRLM; primary endpoint PFS; no outcomes
30953467.caution: Effect size and eligibility derived from a retrospective propensity analysis

30971436.label: BiliSeq original cohort
30971436.result: Sensitivity for HGD/cancer: pathology 48%, sequencing 73%, combined 83%; specificity 99%; NPV 63%
30971436.caution: Only 38 of 252 strictures intrahepatic; panel does not detect FGFR2 fusions

30982687.label: SABR-COMET primary
30982687.result: Median OS 41 vs 28 mo SABR + SOC vs SOC (HR CI 0.30–1.10, p=0.090); PFS 12 vs 6 mo; mixed oligometastases
30982687.caution: Alpha set at 0.20; only 19 of 191 lesions hepatic; three treatment-related deaths

31141112.label: Ecker 2019
31141112.result: No survival benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy, chemoradiotherapy or subtype-matched regimens after ampullary adenocarcinoma resection
31141112.caution: Only 81 matched pairs; half excluded for unknown subtype; no central review

31157963.label: POLO
31157963.result: gBRCA, platinum-sensitive: maintenance olaparib vs placebo delays progression by 3.6 mo; no OS or QoL benefit at this analysis
31157963.caution: Applies to 4.6% of screened; not tested against continued chemotherapy

31188200.label: SECA-II
31188200.result: LT for unresectable liver-only CRLM: OS 100%, 83%, 83% at one, three and five years; median DFS 13.7 mo; no control arm
31188200.caution: Five-year figure rests on two deaths at median 36 mo follow-up

31313827.label: TAE multicentre
31313827.result: Adenoma embolisation: size reduced but no symptom improvement (P=0.134); 10% major complications, one death; surgery still needed in a third

31342472.label: ESGE polyposis 2019
31342472.result: Guideline: ampullary surveillance every 5, 3 or 1 y by appearance and size, shorter interval taking precedence; biopsy discouraged
31342472.caution: Uncited panel intervals; low-quality evidence; endoscopic resection recurrence 22–100%

31419515.label: Barbier 2019
31419515.result: Adenomatosis, median follow-up 10.6 y: malignant transformation 2.5% over a decade; bleeding from nodules as small as 20 mm

31433515.label: Nagtegaal 2020 (WHO 2019)
31433515.result: WHO 2019 narrowed cHCC-CCA: stem-cell subtypes abolished; cholangiolocellular carcinoma moved to small-duct iCCA
31433515.caution: Definitional only; no outcome data or mapping rule for prior literature

31473224.label: Oyama 2020
31473224.result: Branch-duct IPMN: pancreatic carcinoma cumulative incidence 3.3% at 5 y, 6.6% at 10 y, 15.0% at 15 y; risk persists after 5 y even in cysts <15 mm
31473224.caution: Not shown that continued surveillance changes outcome; ~half were concomitant PDACs

31544304.label: Gigante 2019 imaging plus biopsy
31544304.result: Imaging plus biopsy sensitivity ~60% for cHCC-CCA; biopsy under-detects the cholangiocytic component (CK19 33% vs 84%)

31550458.label: Gaspersz 2019 pregnancy
31550458.result: HCA <5 cm in pregnancy: growth in a quarter of pregnancies (median 14 mm increase); no rupture in 51 pregnancies
31550458.caution: Lesions <5 cm only; 27% of referred small 'adenomas' were FNH

31586182.label: Faggiano 2020
31586182.result: MEN1 pNET <2 cm: PFS not reached with lanreotide vs 40 mo with surveillance; a third of treated lesions shrank

31670746.label: MISPHEC
31670746.result: SIRT + first-line cisplatin-gemcitabine: response 39%, 22% to surgery, 20% R0; median OS 22 mo; single-arm
31670746.caution: Hepatic failure in 9 of 12 cirrhotic patients, irreversible in 5

31670750.label: Cercek HAI phase 2
31670750.result: HAI floxuridine + systemic GemOx: response 58%, median PFS 11.8 mo, median OS 25.0 mo; 4 of 38 resected; single-arm
31670750.caution: Only 38 of 84 screened treated; grade 4 pump/arterial complications 11%–30%

31674105.label: Oslo selection criteria
31674105.result: LT for unresectable CRLM: five-year OS 100% with Fong 0-2, 78% with MTV <70 cm3, 67% with Oslo score 0-2
31674105.caution: Thresholds self-derived, not validated; tiny subgroups; no multivariable model

31698521.label: Taiwan series
31698521.result: Two malignant transformations at 3.5 and 4.4 cm, both beta-catenin-activated — counter-examples to the size threshold
31698521.caution: 45 lesions: shows such cases exist, not their frequency

31856076.label: NANETS 2020 surgical
31856076.result: No consensus on liver-metastasis cytoreduction target (majority favoured individualised >70%); cited PFS 20.6 vs 56.1 mo for 70–90% vs >90% debulking

31858509.label: de Vries 2020
31858509.result: Sens/spec: cholangioscopy visual 64/62%, targeted biopsy 15/65%, brush cytology 47/95%; management changed in 17%
31858509.caution: 40% PSC; tests computed on different overlapping subsets, no paired comparison

31987649.label: Bolm 2020
31987649.result: Gemcitabine-based adjuvant therapy associated with longer survival in pancreatobiliary/mixed, not intestinal, ampullary cancer
31987649.caution: Adjuvant therapy allocated by stage, no adjustment; no interaction test

32014119.label: New EPOC long-term
32014119.result: Chemo+cetuximab vs chemo: median OS 55.4 vs 81.0 mo; HR 1.45 (1.02–2.05), p=0.036 (secondary endpoint)
32014119.caution: Primary PFS endpoint no longer significant at maturity; no interim-look correction

32015164.label: NANETS/SNMMI PRRT
32015164.result: Appropriateness: 177Lu-DOTATATE scored 9 for midgut NET progressing on SSA, 8 for pancreatic/unknown primary; SSTR uptake above liver required
32015164.caution: Expert workgroup without stated voting method or evidence grading; one RCT behind it

32090444.label: De Martin 2020
32090444.result: 5-y OS 67% LT vs 40% resection (p=.17); RFS 75 vs 36% (p=.004); recurrence 18 vs 46%; retrospective
32090444.caution: LT arm 100% incidental and waited 394 vs 131 days (selected better tumours)

32105518.label: PREOPANC
32105518.result: Preoperative chemoradiotherapy vs immediate surgery: OS 16.0 vs 14.3 mo, P=.096 — no survival benefit in primary analysis
32105518.caution: Adjuvant gemcitabine comparator no longer standard; big gains from post-randomisation subgroups

32203698.label: FIGHT-202
32203698.result: Pemigatinib: ORR 35.5% with FGFR2 fusions/rearrangements, none without alteration; median OS 21.1 mo; 12-mo PFS 29% — single-arm
32203698.caution: Median OS rests on 40 of 107 deaths; only 9% of prescreened eligible

32272208.label: ESMO 2020 GEP-NEN
32272208.result: Guideline: surgery for selected liver-predominant stage IV; debulking for hormonal symptoms, generally not above Ki-67 10%; LT only under six criteria
32272208.caution: Surgical statements level IV–V; no cytoreduction threshold; predates radioligand data

32402160.label: IMbrave150
32402160.result: Atezolizumab-bevacizumab vs sorafenib: OS HR 0.58 (0.42–0.79); 12-mo OS 67.2 vs 54.6%; median PFS 6.8 vs 4.3 mo
32402160.caution: First interim analysis at 161 of 312 planned deaths; median follow-up 8.6 mo

32416072.label: ClarIDHy
32416072.result: Ivosidenib vs placebo: median PFS 2.7 vs 1.4 mo, HR 0.37 (0.25–0.54); response 2%; OS not significant as randomised (p=0.060)
32416072.caution: 57% of placebo arm crossed over; OS claim relies on crossover adjustment

32484754.label: SABR-COMET long-term
32484754.result: SABR + standard of care vs standard of care: median OS 50 vs 28 mo, HR 0.47 (0.27–0.81); 5-y OS 42.3 vs 17.7%
32484754.caution: Alpha 0.20; liver local control 50%, worst of any site; 19 of 191 lesions hepatic

32666496.label: Herman 2020
32666496.result: Single centre moved resection threshold from 4 cm to 5 cm to a subtype-and-sex rule with comparable outcomes throughout
32666496.caution: No-regression claim at six months rests on an undefined endpoint and short interval

32703081.label: PROPAN
32703081.result: No study of a prophylactic total pancreatectomy programme exists; pooled total pancreatectomy mortality 6%
32703081.caution: Indirect evidence only; mortality quoted to patients (2–5%) is below its own pooled 6%

32707595.label: WFUMB CEUS 2020
32707595.result: Guideline: CEUS first-line for incidental indeterminate focal liver lesion in non-cirrhotic liver without suspected malignancy (LoE 1, strong)
32707595.caution: No search strategy or evidence tables; several LoE 5 recommendations graded strong

32729276.label: Kim 2020 WHO 2019 imaging impact
32729276.result: Review: 2019 WHO changes make older cHCC-CCA imaging and outcome series non-comparable
32729276.caution: No quantification of reclassification; no data under the new definition

32771427.label: Bariatric review
32771427.result: Adenoma after bariatric surgery: weight loss correlates with fewer lesions but not smaller ones
32771427.caution: Seven patients; does not show bariatric surgery treats adenoma

32818466.label: ROAR
32818466.result: Dabrafenib + trametinib, BRAF V600E BTC: investigator-assessed ORR 51%, median PFS 9 mo; single-arm, no comparator
32818466.caution: Interim analysis; central review scored lower; 8% progression-free at 24 mo

32970878.label: Jaradat 2021
32970878.result: All 19 misdiagnosed as HCC (4 of 4 biopsies); 36.8% beyond Milan; recurrence 64.7% at median 4 mo; case series
32970878.caution: Case series; tumour burden not controlled

32984213.label: CEPS adenoma
32984213.result: Single paediatric case: HNF1A-inactivated adenoma shrank marginally (11.5 to 10 cm) after portosystemic shunt closure
32984213.caution: Single case; does not demonstrate regression

33015329.label: Microforceps meta-analysis
33015329.result: Through-the-needle microforceps biopsy: technical success ~97%, diagnostic yield 80%, accuracy 83%, serious adverse events ~1%
33015329.caution: Superiority over FNA unproven (two retrospective comparisons, OR 1.1–67)

33153555.label: ACR AC liver lesion 2020
33153555.result: Guideline: lesion >1 cm, CEUS, multiphase CT or MRI equally appropriate; MRI if sub-centimetre in cancer patient; biopsy usually inappropriate in normal liver
33153555.caution: Panel-median ratings; cited specificity of 'equivalent' modalities ranges 38% to 82%

33166497.label: DOSISPHERE-01
33166497.result: Personalised (≥205 Gy) vs standard 120 Gy dosimetry: ORR 71 vs 36%; median OS 26.6 vs 10.7 mo; not a comparison with sorafenib
33166497.caution: Stopped early for efficacy; unmasked response endpoint; PFS not significantly different

33264544.label: KEYNOTE-177
33264544.result: Pembrolizumab vs chemotherapy: median PFS 16.5 vs 8.2 mo; responses ongoing at two years 82.6 vs 35.3%; OS benefit not established
33264544.caution: PH failed, curves cross early; 29.4% progressed as best response

33276780.label: Ishii 2020 recurrence patterns
33276780.result: 5-y RFS 12.2% after cHCC-CCA resection; OS intermediate, not significantly different from HCC/iCCA

33316425.label: Dageforde 12-centre
33316425.result: LT within Milan: 5-y OS 70.1% cHCC-CCA vs 73.4% HCC (p=0.806); recurrence 23.1 vs 11.5%
33316425.caution: Only 2 of 99 recipients knowingly transplanted with the diagnosis

33362387.label: Yang 2020 CEUS
33362387.result: CEUS LI-RADS for cHCC-CCA: sensitivity 40%, AUC 0.649; PPV at real prevalence 1.6-39.6%

33475684.label: SWOG S1505
33475684.result: Perioperative mFOLFIRINOX or gem/nab-paclitaxel: resection 70–73%, R0 85%, 2-y survival 47–48%; neither arm beat 40% historical benchmark
33475684.caution: No randomised control; 31% of enrolled excluded from analysis

33588146.label: EANM Focus 3
33588146.result: Delphi consensus: Ga-68-DOTA-SSA PET/CT preferred at staging/restaging; FDG PET for mismatch; PRRT second line after SSA in GI NET (Krenning 3–4)
33588146.caution: No consensus on 12 of 43 questions incl. PRRT sequencing; no quality grading; industry-funded

33728632.label: ESGE ampullary 2021
33728632.result: Guideline: papillectomy first-line for adenoma without intraductal extension; surgery if intraductal extension >20 mm or size >4 cm; PD for T1 or above
33728632.caution: Nine of eleven main recommendations strong on low-quality evidence

33731599.label: Glucose meta-analysis 2
33731599.result: Low intracystic glucose (≤50 mg/dL) is a cheap, highly sensitive marker of mucinous pancreatic cyst
33731599.caution: Specificity imprecise (I2 ~79%); three cutoffs pooled; pseudocysts share low glucose

33739462.label: LEGACY
33739462.result: Y-90: ORR 88.3% by localised mRECIST (62.2% lasting ≥6 mo); 3-y OS 86.6% — single-arm, no comparator
33739462.caution: ORR 46.3% by RECIST 1.1; 28% went on to transplant or resection

33783475.label: PANDORA
33783475.result: Surveillance of non-functional pNET ≤2 cm: no disease-related death at median 17 mo; interim analysis
33783475.caution: Poor adherence; six of eight progressing patients refused surgery

33798493.label: ABC-06
33798493.result: FOLFOX + ASC vs ASC alone: median OS 6.2 vs 5.3 mo; adjusted HR 0.69 (0.50–0.97); 12-mo OS 25.9 vs 11.4%
33798493.caution: 69% grade 3-5 toxicity; ORR 5%; 44% iCCA not analysed separately

33964311.label: Glucose meta-analysis
33964311.result: Cyst fluid glucose (<~50 mg/dL) vs CEA for mucinous cyst: sensitivity 91 vs 56%, accuracy 94 vs 85%; combining adds nothing
33964311.caution: Non-histologic reference standard in most studies; nothing on dysplasia grade

33985906.label: Haring 2021 pregnancy
33985906.result: A third of untreated adenomas grew in pregnancy; 6.5 cm threshold is the smallest published haemorrhage size, not a derived cut-point

34023067.label: ASGE hilar
34023067.result: Conditional: bilateral stents if liver not atrophic; metal preferred to avoid reintervention; against routine first-line percutaneous drainage before resection
34023067.caution: All recommendations low-quality evidence; >50% liver drainage target is ungraded opinion

34113169.label: Yu 2021 mismatch repair
34113169.result: dMMR in 2 of 97 primary liver carcinomas and none of 24 cHCC-CCA
34113169.caution: 24 cases cannot exclude a clinically relevant low frequency

34155783.label: Dutch male series
34155783.result: Half of presumed adenomas in men reclassified on expert review, a quarter to HCC; beta-catenin mutations missed by immunohistochemistry alone

34213048.label: Chen 2021 Taiwan nationwide
34213048.result: cHCC-CCA 5-y survival 25.7% in unselected national registry; treatment comparisons confounded by indication
34213048.caution: TACE estimates directionally contradictory; cannot guide therapy

34230073.label: Wild 2021 GLP-1R review
34230073.result: Review: GLP-1R exendin tracer imaging for occult benign insulinoma and adult nesidioblastosis; nothing on non-functioning pNET
34230073.caution: Unsystematic review by the tracer's developers

34283065.label: Renzulli 2021 locoregional
34283065.result: Review of locoregional techniques for biliary liver cancer; cHCC-CCA content extrapolated from cholangiocarcinoma, no pooled estimates
34283065.caution: No account of how tumour vascularity should drive modality choice

34289649.label: CEUS LR-M meta
34289649.result: CEUS LR-M: ~54% HCC and 40% non-HCC malignancy; early washout in 79% of non-HCC malignancy
34289649.caution: Quoted '94% malignant' is a sum of two pooled proportions, no CI

34331914.label: MERITS-LT
34331914.result: UNOS-DS: 83.3% downstaged; 2-y dropout 37.3%; 2-y post-LT survival 95%; explants beyond Milan 42.8%; prospective
34331914.caution: Post-LT follow-up median 1.7 years in 63; TACE vs Y-90 comparison unadjusted

34333196.label: AFEF 2021
34333196.result: Consensus: adenoma surveillance may stop after menopause; non-invasive diagnosis of HNF1A-inactivated adenoma endorsed
34333196.caution: Adenoma recommendations graded C1–D2; β-catenin subtype needs biopsy

34334644.label: Julien 2021
34334644.result: Size acted continuously (OR 1.02 per mm), no identifiable cut-point; sonic hedgehog subtype OR 21, alcohol OR 9, β-catenin exon 7/8 OR 6.5; retrospective

34347159.label: Ablation meta-analysis
34347159.result: Ablation of iCCA: pooled OS 82.4% at 1 y, 28.5% at 5 y; technical success 91.9%, major complications 5.7%; worse if >3 cm or multiple
34347159.caution: 20 retrospective series; I squared up to 85%; publication bias at 3 y

34506756.label: IHPBA 2021
34506756.result: Consensus: first vocabulary, selection framework and algorithm for LT in non-resectable CRLM; risk criteria incl. MTV 70 cm³, TLG 260, CEA >80
34506756.caution: Cut-points unvalidated, from one centre; consensus required only 70% agreement

34529357.label: Soons 2021 FAP duodenum
34529357.result: Review: about half of FAP duodenal cancers are (peri)ampullary; Spigelman misses ampullary risk; no evidence endoscopic therapy prevents cancer
34529357.caution: Narrative review; only 181 patients in 7 small retrospective series

34541864.label: EPOCH
34541864.result: SIRT + 2nd-line chemo vs chemo: PFS 8.0 vs 7.2 mo (HR 0.69), hepatic PFS 9.1 vs 7.2 (HR 0.59); OS 14.0 vs 14.4 mo (HR 1.07)
34541864.caution: Grade ≥3 toxicity 68% vs 49%; manufacturer collaborated on design and analysis

34554208.label: ClarIDHy final OS
34554208.result: Median OS 10.3 vs 7.5 mo ivosidenib vs placebo; HR 0.79 (0.56–1.12), P=.09 — OS not met as randomised; ORR 2%
34554208.caution: 70% of controls crossed over; significance requires crossover-adjustment model

34688956.label: ASTRO EBRT
34688956.result: Guideline: EBRT a named first-line option for liver-confined HCC when curative treatment is not available; dose, fractionation and OAR tables
34688956.caution: No randomised comparison with ablation, embolisation or surgery at search cut-off

34783596.label: LI-RADS IPD meta-analysis
34783596.result: Washout and arterial phase hyperenhancement carry LI-RADS; enhancing capsule contributes weakly, threshold growth not at all
34783596.caution: Odds ratios invert direction between analysis cohorts; no stable effect sizes

34793718.label: NETTER-1 final OS
34793718.result: 177Lu-Dotatate vs high-dose octreotide: median OS 48.0 vs 36.3 mo; HR 0.84 (0.60–1.17), p=0.30 — final OS endpoint not met
34793718.caution: 41 of 114 controls (36%) crossed over to PRRT

34801630.label: BCLC 2022
34801630.result: Guideline: 2022 BCLC algorithm adds liver-function and patient layer above tumour burden; radioembolisation for single nodules up to 8 cm
34801630.caution: Expert narrative: no search strategy, voting or liver-function thresholds

34818478.label: LITESPARK-004
34818478.result: Belzutifan in VHL: pancreatic NET response 91% (n=22); no pancreatic surgery required over 22 mo
34818478.caution: Uncontrolled secondary endpoint; universal anaemia; no durability data

34856012.label: Bioulac-Sage 2022
34856012.result: Review: HCA complication rates biased by surgical-only sampling; bleeding occurs below 50 mm, yet size still used as the decision variable

34859465.label: Sapisochin review
34859465.result: Review: LT outcomes better for single iCCA ≤2 cm than larger or multifocal disease; no LT-vs-resection comparison free of selection bias
34859465.caution: Explant-defined cohorts with no waitlist dropout data

34873870.label: Kryklyva 2021
34873870.result: Early-onset (<50 y) carcinomas: dMMR in 47.8% duodenal vs 1/23 ampullary and 2/44 pancreatic
34873870.caution: Recommendation to test all early-onset ampullary cancers rests on a single case

34902530.label: IMbrave150 update
34902530.result: Atezolizumab-bevacizumab vs sorafenib: median OS 19.2 vs 13.4 mo, HR 0.66; median PFS 6.9 vs 4.3 mo; ORR 30%
34902530.caution: Post hoc, descriptive p values; non-viral HCC HR 1.05 (0.68–1.63)

34925507.label: Chen 2021 SEER nomogram
34925507.result: No significant change in US cHCC-CCA incidence; LT survival advantage over resection in 32 matched pairs — hypothesis-generating
34925507.caution: No pathological covariates and no waitlist denominator

35018302.label: Ziogas 2022 UNOS
35018302.result: LT for hepatic adenoma: post-LT 1/3/5-y OS 94.2%/89.7%/86.3%; crude waitlist mortality 9.0%
35018302.caution: Number and size of adenomas not recorded

35084987.label: PREOPANC long-term
35084987.result: Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy vs upfront surgery: 5-y OS 20.5% vs 6.5%; HR 0.73; 59 mo follow-up
35084987.caution: Comparator was adjuvant gemcitabine alone; median OS difference only 1.4 mo

35164930.label: CEUS LI-RADS meta
35164930.result: HCC proportion by CEUS LI-RADS: LR-2 2%, LR-3 about 21%, LR-5 97%, LR-M 44%
35164930.caution: I-squared 83–98%; mostly retrospective, dependent on two Chinese HBV cohorts

35258371.label: TRACE
35258371.result: Median OS 30.2 vs 15.6 mo, TTP 17.1 vs 9.5 mo, Y-90 radioembolisation vs DEB-TACE
35258371.caution: Stopped at interim with 72 of 136 planned; single centre, unblinded local imaging

35333776.label: Lammert 2022
35333776.result: Haemorrhage 13% in adenomas >5 cm vs 0% below; 69% regression after contraceptive cessation
35333776.caution: Only 10 bleeding events; median bleeding size 8.7 cm

35353121.label: North American LDLT
35353121.result: LDLT for unresectable CRLM: all 10 recipients alive at median 1.5 y; 30% recurred within 200 days; all donors recovered
35353121.caution: No oncological benefit shown; 79 evaluated but not transplanted undescribed

35380181.label: Zheng-Pywell 2022
35380181.result: Resected NF-PNET <2 cm: Black patients had roughly double the nodal metastasis rate; size did not predict nodal spread in them
35380181.caution: Rests on 7 of 30 patients; not replicated below 1 cm; operated cohort only

35425706.label: CEUS versus CT/MRI LI-RADS
35425706.result: CEUS vs CT/MRI LI-RADS: HCC risk similar except LR-3 (21 vs 35%) and LR-M (56 vs 33%); LR-5 performs equivalently
35425706.caution: LR-M specificity/accuracy unreliable: table rows duplicated from LR-5 analysis

35617978.label: RASER
35617978.result: Radiation segmentectomy, solitary HCC ≤3 cm: initial CR 83%, sustained CR 90% of target lesions; complete necrosis in all eight explants
35617978.caution: No comparator; 44% censored by transplant or loss; 24 mo follow-up

35633905.label: Choi 2022
35633905.result: Endoscopic papillectomy: curative resection 76%, surgery avoided 93%; positive/uncertain margin predicted early and piecemeal resection late recurrence
35633905.caution: Predictors based on 11-13 events with very wide CIs

35654476.label: Laimer 2022 SRFA
35654476.result: Stereotactic multiprobe RFA of HCA: technical efficacy 97.4%, no major complications over four years of follow-up
35654476.caution: 14 patients, single centre; no tissue to confirm what was ablated

35834226.label: Alliance A021501
35834226.result: 8 cycles neoadjuvant mFOLFIRINOX: median OS 29.8 mo, 18-mo OS 66.7% vs historical 50%; no support for adding hypofractionated RT
35834226.caution: No randomised control; design forbids comparing the arms

35869798.label: Resection vs transplant
35869798.result: Milan-in NELM, LT vs resection: ten-year OS 93% vs 75%, ten-year DFS 52% vs 18%; unadjusted, single centre
35869798.caution: Arms separated by resectability; no adjustment beyond univariate table

35920706.label: HBP adenoma subtypes
35920706.result: HBP iso/hyperintensity in 0% of H-HCA vs 59% (95% CI 26–88%) of B-HCA; FNH specificity falls from 89% to 65% once H-/I-HCA excluded
35920706.caution: Only 33 B-HCAs, largely from case reports

35923628.label: Yang 2022 SEER
35923628.result: NF-PanNET ≤2 cm, surgery vs observation: equal cancer-specific survival after propensity matching (259 pairs)
35923628.caution: Unoperated group older and sicker; selection, not resection benefit

35949295.label: SURF trial
35949295.result: Surgery vs RFA, HCC ≤3 cm: median RFS 3.46 vs 3.04 y; HR 0.92 (0.67–1.25), p=0.58; local recurrence 8.0 vs 15.8%
35949295.caution: Stopped at 301 analysable of 600 planned; mostly solitary <2 cm

35978598.label: LCSGJ iCCA 2022
35978598.result: Guideline: resect solitary node-negative iCCA at any size; drugs first for nodal or multifocal disease; GemCis + S-1 if unresectable
35978598.caution: LCSGJ staging (2 cm T cut-off) incompatible with UICC 8th edition; no nodal dissection advice

35986682.label: ASPEN interim
35986682.result: NF-pNEN ≤2 cm: 81% managed by surveillance; distant metastases 0/406 under surveillance at median 25-mo follow-up
35986682.caution: Strategies never compared; 25 mo too short for the trial's question

36048453.label: PRODIGE 24 five-year
36048453.result: mFOLFIRINOX vs gemcitabine: median OS 53.5 vs 35.5 mo; 5-y OS 43.2% vs 31.4%
36048453.caution: Effect smaller than 3-y report; 5-y DFS differs by only 7 points

36083140.label: AASLD PSC/CCA 2023
36083140.result: Guidance: annual MRI/MRCP surveillance in PSC; histology mandatory for iCCA; LT after neoadjuvant therapy for perihilar CCA ≤3 cm
36083140.caution: Ungraded expert consensus; contradicts itself on iCCA LT (research-only vs ≤2 cm)

36089523.label: AISF 2022
36089523.result: GRADE guideline: all size-based recommendations (5 cm resection trigger, 6-month decision point) very low quality evidence, conditional
36089523.caution: Risk-defining beta-catenin subtype cannot be seen on imaging

36209796.label: PancreaSeq prospective
36209796.result: Cyst fluid NGS: mucinous cysts sensitivity 90%, specificity 100%; advanced neoplasia 89%/98%; 93%/95% combined with cytology
36209796.caution: Outcome impact not shown; thresholds tuned in same group's earlier cohorts

36241941.label: Grut metabolic tumour volume
36241941.result: Pre-LT PET metabolic tumour volume <70 vs >70 cm3: 5-y OS 76% vs 21%, 10-y OS 50% vs 7%; prognostic association
36241941.caution: 70 cm3 cut fitted by ROC in the same patients; never tested elsewhere

36252154.label: ASCO 2023
36252154.result: Guideline: first-line doublet chemotherapy for most mCRC; anti-EGFR only for left-sided RAS wild-type; no oxaliplatin HIPEC; offer surgery if resectable
36252154.caution: Resectability, FLR and staged hepatectomy out of scope; search closed June 2022

36260828.label: E2211 CAPTEM
36260828.result: Median PFS 22.7 vs 14.4 mo CAPTEM vs temozolomide — primary endpoint met at interim; final PFS HR 0.71 (0.46–1.07); OS NS (P=0.42)
36260828.caution: Met at adjusted two-sided alpha 0.119; grade 3–4 toxicity doubled

36324268.label: Haring 2022 resection audit
36324268.result: 44/222 (20%) resections for presumed HCA were lesions <50 mm; 70% of these had diagnosis changed, a fifth proved FNH; retrospective

36372281.label: ESMO BTC 2023 guideline
36372281.result: Guideline: core biopsy and molecular profiling; resection with lymphadenectomy; adjuvant capecitabine; GemCis + durvalumab first line; FOLFOX second line
36372281.caution: Surgical recommendations mostly level III–V; iCCA transplantation not mentioned

36405111.label: Zhang 2022 radical resection
36405111.result: After radical resection of cHCC-CCA: median OS 26.8 mo, 5-y OS 23.6%; CA19-9, Child-Pugh and tumour number adverse
36405111.caution: Multivariable model has implausibly protective AFP coefficient

36434154.label: NETPET validation
36434154.result: NETPET score independently predicted OS and time to progression alongside histological grade
36434154.caution: Two of three centres supplied derivation data; treatment not adjusted for

36434481.label: Makris 2023
36434481.result: Radiographic calcification: adverse pathology and shorter RFS (HR 11.5, 1.1–125.0); cystic morphology favourable but not independent
36434481.caution: Nearly 30% of exposure data missing; no observed patients

36502926.label: Medullary ampullary carcinoma
36502926.result: Medullary type is 3% of ampullary cancer: strongly MMR-deficient, BRAF wild-type, almost uniformly PD-L1 positive; supports routine MMR testing
36502926.caution: Less aggressive behaviour or immunotherapy benefit not established

36521097.label: APACT
36521097.result: Nab-paclitaxel+gem vs gem: independent DFS 19.4 vs 18.8 mo, P=.18 — primary endpoint not met; OS 41.8 vs 37.7 mo (descriptive)
36521097.caution: OS a descriptive secondary endpoint; 15% grade 3 neuropathy

36521500.label: ESPAC5
36521500.result: Feasibility RCT: no improvement in resection or R0 rate with neoadjuvant therapy; 1-y survival 76% vs 39% favouring neoadjuvant (secondary endpoint)
36521500.caution: Missed recruitment target; 90 patients, 12 mo follow-up

36546651.label: Sotorasib CodeBreaK 100
36546651.result: Single-arm: sotorasib produced tumour shrinkage in about a fifth of KRAS G12C pancreatic cancers
36546651.caution: No prespecified benchmark or hypothesis test; signal, not benefit

36587061.label: Yoon 2022
36587061.result: HGD/adenocarcinoma after papillectomy: similar OS with or without radical surgery; RFS favoured surgery (p=0.052, 55 matched)
36587061.caution: Allocation driven by matching variables; T stage not reported

36652354.label: FOENIX-CCA2
36652354.result: Futibatinib, FGFR2-rearranged iCCA: ORR 42% (central review); median PFS 9.0 mo; median OS 21.7 mo; single-arm, no comparator
36652354.caution: OS from 17.1-mo median follow-up; only 14% of responders still responding at a year

36681415.label: ASCOT
36681415.result: ITT 3-y OS 77.1% S-1 vs 67.6% observation; HR 0.69 (0.51–0.94) — primary endpoint met
36681415.caution: Only 13% iCCA (subgroup interval 0.30 to 1.89); RFS not significant

36725249.label: SNMMI/EANM SSTR PET
36725249.result: Technical standard for SSTR PET acquisition, interpretation and reporting incl. modified Krenning score and pancreatic head uptake pitfall
36725249.caution: Consensus without evidence grading; no guidance for small surveilled pancreatic lesions

36753993.label: Pomej 2023 European cohort
36753993.result: Chemotherapy vs none: median OS 15.5 vs 5.3 mo, p=0.052, NS on multivariable analysis; checkpoint inhibitor subgroup 17.8 mo

36781070.label: European practice survey
36781070.result: Survey: four fifths of European experts decline EASL advice to resect adenomas >5 cm after lifestyle change; only half have MDT infrastructure
36781070.caution: 21% response rate; stated rather than observed practice

36924180.label: ENETS 2023 NEC
36924180.result: Guidance (digestive NEC): resect localised disease; carboplatin + etoposide first line; advises against metastasectomy and PRRT
36924180.caution: Almost no prospective evidence; well-differentiated NET G3 excluded

37075781.label: KEYNOTE-966
37075781.result: Pembrolizumab + gem-cis vs gem-cis: median OS 12.7 vs 10.9 mo; HR 0.83 (0.72–0.95) — primary endpoint met; ORR 29% in both
37075781.caution: 88% metastatic; no predictive biomarker; not an iCCA-specific result

37084797.label: EASL-ILCA iCCA 2023
37084797.result: Guideline: biopsy for diagnosis; six months adjuvant oral fluoropyrimidine; gem-cis + durvalumab first line; LT for cirrhotic iCCA ≤3 cm under protocol
37084797.caution: Surgical/locoregional guidance mostly level 4; 3 cm LT ceiling untested by cited studies

37099736.label: Adagrasib KRYSTAL-1
37099736.result: Pancreatic subgroup: response rate 33.3% in 21 patients; no comparator
37099736.caution: Unpowered subgroup; justifies a randomised trial, not a treatment claim

37174120.label: Auer 2023 interventional
37174120.result: Review: cHCC-CCA systemic therapy defaults to the biliary tract cancer paradigm by extrapolation from iCCA
37174120.caution: No entity-specific pooled estimates; HCC-like genomic data not addressed

37199193.label: AASLD HCC 2023
37199193.result: Guideline: US HCC reference from surveillance to diagnosis, expanded LT/downstaging criteria, TACE/Y-90 suitability and systemic lines
37199193.caution: No mandatory systematic review or GRADE; two positions since reversed or overtaken

37245629.label: US male series
37245629.result: In men, malignant transformation occurred in beta-catenin-inflammatory and unclassified subtypes; androgen receptor staining did not predict it

37307900.label: ASGE 2023
37307900.result: Conditional, very low evidence: add biopsy to brushing; cholangioscopy if non-distal; EUS after non-diagnostic ERCP; no hilar puncture in LT candidates
37307900.caution: Best combination sensitivity 0.66 to 0.88; negative work-up excludes nothing

37329889.label: CAIRO5
37329889.result: Right-sided or RAS/BRAF-mutant: FOLFOXIRI-bevacizumab vs doublet PFS 10.6 vs 9.0 mo (HR 0.76); complete local treatment 51% vs 37%
37329889.caution: OS not reported; panitumumab comparison stopped for futility

37406887.label: Marchegiani 2023
37406887.result: BD-IPMN stable 5 y: cancer incidence not above age-matched population if >75 y with cyst <30 mm, or >65 y with cyst ≤15 mm
37406887.caution: Only 2-3 cancers in these subgroups; late risk not excluded

37471075.label: New EPOC biomarker
37471075.result: Liver-metastasis expression subtype: 5-y PFS 43% immune, 26% stromal, 14% canonical; OS difference not significant
37471075.caution: Needs resected metastatic tissue; no interaction with randomised treatment

37473969.label: nCLE training study
37473969.result: Training brought nCLE-naive endosonographers to 89% accuracy for mucinous vs non-mucinous cysts at a median of 38 cases; durable at 8 weeks
37473969.caution: Subtype sensitivities 57–73%, kappa as low as 0.32; video reading only

37494056.label: Oslo cohort
37494056.result: LT for CRLM: median OS 60.3 mo; 5-y OS 50.4% from LT (42.6% from listing); ten-year OS 88.9% with Oslo score 0
37494056.caution: Oslo score derived in same patients; univariable only; favourable strata of 5 to 19

37578384.label: ENETS 2023 functioning
37578384.result: Guideline: insulinoma, parenchyma-sparing resection without lymphadenectomy; gastrinoma, lymphadenectomy + duodenotomy; liver cytoreduction target 70%–90%+
37578384.caution: Surgical/interventional statements level 2b–5; MEN1 operation left unresolved

37595391.label: Gamble 2023
37595391.result: Benign ampullary biopsy did not exclude malignancy: almost 9% of biopsies with follow-up were benign where resection showed cancer
37595391.caution: Estimates from the third of patients with follow-up pathology

37678671.label: ESMO 2023 pancreatic
37678671.result: Guideline: against neoadjuvant therapy in resectable PDAC (grade II, E); induction therapy supported for borderline resectable disease on weaker evidence
37678671.caution: No described literature search; predates the 2025 trials and meta-analyses

37708904.label: NAPOLI 3
37708904.result: NALIRIFOX vs nab-paclitaxel+gemcitabine: median OS 11.1 vs 9.2 mo; HR 0.83, p=0.036
37708904.caution: Response-rate endpoint failed; immature follow-up; no comparison with FOLFIRINOX

37770126.label: BSG CCA 2023
37770126.result: Guideline: 50 GRADE-graded recommendations incl. 24 weeks adjuvant capecitabine, early molecular profiling, iCCA LT only within a national protocol
37770126.caution: Search closed November 2022, before KEYNOTE-966, HER2 and futibatinib data

37774329.label: ASCO 2023 systemic
37774329.result: Guideline: SSA first; PRRT after progression in receptor-positive GI NET; PRRT, CAPTEM, everolimus or sunitinib (unordered) for pancreatic NET
37774329.caution: No sequence recommended after progression; most recommendations weak

37870968.label: CodeBreaK 300
37870968.result: Sotorasib 960 mg + panitumumab vs trifluridine-tipiracil or regorafenib: median PFS 5.6 mo, roughly double control; no OS gain shown
37870968.caution: Not powered for OS; median follow-up 7.8 mo

37877341.label: ENETS 2023 NF-PanNET
37877341.result: Guideline: observe NF-PanNET ≤1 cm, individualise 1–2 cm, operate >2 cm or with duct dilation; stage with SSTR-PET/CT
