37877341.caution: Surgical thresholds level 3 evidence; follow-up schedule level 5

38015261.label: Han 2023 recurrence timing
38015261.result: Recurrence after papillectomy 16.1% (5.8 per 100 person-years); recurrences up to 9.75 y, roughly half after 2-y surveillance window
38015261.caution: Mean follow-up 2.8 y shorter than mean time to recurrence 3.2 y; event counts inconsistent

38059651.label: Gigante 2024 atezo-bev
38059651.result: First-line atezolizumab-bevacizumab in cHCC-CCA (nine patients): response 33%, PFS 3 mo, OS 13 mo; two severe GI bleeds
38059651.caution: Far too small to establish benefit

38092727.label: Calderaro 2023 deep learning
38092727.result: Deep-learning HCC-like vs iCCA-like cHCC-CCA: 5-y post-transplant survival 76.4% vs 45.4%; pathologist agreement kappa 0.19

38182527.label: Kyoto 2024
38182527.result: Guideline: surveillance may stop for a stable cyst <20 mm at 5 y (SIGN grade C); 2.5 mm/year growth and new-onset diabetes added as worrisome features
38182527.caution: No operating characteristics for risk tiers; malignancy rates from resected series

38237621.label: NORPACT-1
38237621.result: ITT primary 18-mo survival 60 vs 73%, neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX vs upfront surgery — no survival benefit shown
38237621.caution: A fifth of neoadjuvant arm never got the drug; only 61% of treated completed four cycles

38261915.label: MALRIC primary
38261915.result: PSM: microwave ablation vs resection 5-y OS 44.8 vs 40.4%; DFS favoured resection; margin >5 mm required
38261915.caution: Equivalence not shown; entry single tumour ≤5 cm, not support for a 3 cm rule

38319892.label: HIMALAYA / STRIDE
38319892.result: STRIDE vs sorafenib: median OS 16.43 vs 13.77 mo; HR 0.78 (96.02% CI 0.65–0.93); 36-mo OS 30.7 vs 20.2%; durvalumab non-inferior
38319892.caution: No PFS benefit; curves separate only after 9 months

38319896.label: TOPAZ-1
38319896.result: Durvalumab + GemCis vs GemCis: OS HR 0.80 (0.66–0.97); 24-mo OS 24.9 vs 10.4%; median gain 1.3 mo
38319896.caution: Interim analysis (424 of 496 deaths); PH violated; 86% metastatic

38343605.label: Chu 2023 review
38343605.result: Review: transplantation is not an established indication for cHCC-CCA; tabulates resection and transplant survival literature
38343605.caution: No evidence grading; selection asymmetry between modalities not flagged

38425471.label: Yang 2024 nodal mapping
38425471.result: Nodal recurrence after liver resection mapped to hepatic hilum (62.3%) and portal vein–vena cava region (39.6%)
38425471.caution: Only 11 of 53 had cHCC-CCA; no outcome validation

38442782.label: Gardner 2024 review
38442782.result: Narrative review comparing the five major cyst guidelines; frames surveillance cessation as a population-vs-individual trade-off
38442782.caution: No new evidence; malignancy estimates are the authors' consensus

38608150.label: Dutch HAI phase II
38608150.result: HAI floxuridine + FOLFOX/FOLFIRI: 90% completed two combined cycles (70% threshold); device complications 16%; single-arm feasibility
38608150.caution: Grade ≥3 events 45% in first two cycles, 66% by six months; efficacy immature

38728364.label: TRICE
38728364.result: ORR 84.7 vs 79.7% cetuximab + FOLFOXIRI vs cetuximab + FOLFOX, p=0.42 — primary endpoint failed; resection 54.2 vs 52.7%
38728364.caution: Survival immature; response and resectability judged locally, unmasked

38838500.label: FIGHT-202 final
38838500.result: Pemigatinib, FGFR2-fusion cohort: ORR 37.0%; median PFS 7.0 mo; median OS 17.5 mo; no responses outside FGFR2 fusions; single-arm
38838500.caution: Grade ≥3 adverse events in 68.7%; two-thirds progressed within a year

38851203.label: NETTER-2
38851203.result: 177Lu-Dotatate + octreotide vs high-dose octreotide: median PFS 22.8 vs 8.5 mo, HR 0.276 (0.182–0.418); ORR 43% vs 9.3%
38851203.caution: OS immature with 48% of controls crossed over; QoL deterioration identical

38860996.label: Kono 2024 CEUS validation
38860996.result: CEUS resolved a third of CT/MRI-indeterminate (LR-3/LR-NC) observations; management changed correctly in 24 of 25
38860996.caution: 97% cirrhotic; says nothing about incidental masses in non-cirrhotic liver

38880125.label: Revised Kyoto validation
38880125.result: Carcinoma prevalence 49% with high-risk stigmata vs 1.3% with worrisome features vs 0.05% with neither; hazard rises stepwise with WF count
38880125.caution: Same-centre overlap, not external validation; surveillance protocol and 30 mm threshold untested

38958301.label: ACG 2024
38958301.result: Guideline (HCA): women ≥5 cm — risk-factor change, 6–12-mo observation, resect if not <5 cm; men/β-catenin earlier review; LT considered if unresectable
38958301.caution: Conditional recommendations on low-quality evidence; post-2016 studies not engaged

38965925.label: Chun 2024 hepatectomy
38965925.result: 5-y survival 56.4% after hepatectomy for cHCC-CCA; 93.3% vs 35.8% without vs with lymphovascular invasion
38965925.caution: Nomogram internally derived, externally unvalidated, built on post-resection variables

38977327.label: ENETS 2024 small intestine
38977327.result: Guideline: resect liver-only G1/G2 disease if R0 achievable (B-4); liver-directed therapy for non-surgical candidates (B-3); prefer bland embolisation
38977327.caution: Liver-metastasis advice in weakest grades; no cytoreduction threshold or Ki-67 limit set

39266864.label: Carcinoid crisis in PRRT
39266864.result: Review: crisis risk dominated by midgut primary and high hepatic burden; onset 12–48 h after a dose, usually the first; none in 127 audited administrations
39266864.caution: Quoted 1–2% incidence has no pooled denominator; risk factors from case reports only

39282913.label: CABINET
39282913.result: Cabozantinib vs placebo, median PFS: pNET 13.8 vs 4.4 mo, HR 0.23 (0.12–0.42); extrapancreatic 8.4 vs 3.9 mo, HR 0.38 (0.25–0.59)
39282913.caution: OS not shown (HR 0.86 and 0.95, with crossover); stopped early on local assessments

39285860.label: Asia-Pacific 2024
39285860.result: Consensus: biopsy + cytology at index ERCP; drain >50% of viable liver, stent number by Bismuth type; EUS-guided or percutaneous rescue
39285860.caution: Only 56% to 57% fully accepted drainage/stent statements; endoscopic scope only

39306468.label: TransMet
39306468.result: LT + chemotherapy vs chemotherapy: 5-y ITT OS 56.6% vs 12.6%; HR 0.37 (0.21–0.65)
39306468.caution: Highly selected: central panel rejects 40% of referrals; median wait to LT 50.5 days

39322951.label: Yuan 2024 RCT
39322951.result: HCC with portal hypertension, hepatectomy vs ablation-based treatment: 5-y OS 69.3 vs 64.9%, HR 1.28 — no significant difference
39322951.caution: Portal pressure never measured; nearly all Child-Pugh A, mean tumour 2.6 cm

39375615.label: Li 2024 clinicopathology
39375615.result: Reports actionable HER2 and FGFR2 frequencies and an immune-infiltrate signal in resected cHCC-CCA
39375615.caution: 30% CCA-component prognostic threshold circularly derived and unvalidated

39395114.label: Itanet 2024 RLT
39395114.result: Consensus: 177Lu-DOTATATE second line in SSTR+ GEP-NET, ahead of high-dose SSA, everolimus, sunitinib and chemotherapy; use early
39395114.caution: Only the comparison with high-dose SSA is randomised; silent on surgery and liver-directed therapy

39526315.label: Heo 2024 Korea
39526315.result: In a low-contraceptive-use Asian population, HCA far more often male and beta-catenin-activated than in Western series
39526315.caution: Imaging score internally validated only; funded by contrast-agent manufacturer

39642968.label: Pancreas2000 EP vs TSA
39642968.result: Surgical ampullectomy vs papillectomy: initial R0 90 vs 73%; recurrence after R0 3.2 vs 16%; papillectomy failed in two-thirds of T1 cancers
39642968.caution: Matched 1-in-9 endoscopic selection; surgical follow-up twice as long; recurrence gap inflated

39689874.label: ESGE 2025
39689874.result: Guideline: perihilar stricture — add fluoroscopy-guided biopsy to brush cytology; EUS sampling only if curative resection not feasible
39689874.caution: Seven of eight recommendations conditional on low/very low quality evidence

39690085.label: EASL HCC 2025
39690085.result: Guideline: AFP ceiling 1,000 ng/ml for listing; RFA and MWA equivalent; resection not to be used as a downstaging procedure
39690085.caution: Most surgical and transplant items LoE 3 to 4 expert consensus; no disclosures printed

39693584.label: SBRT vs RFA
39693584.result: Local PFS SBRT vs RFA: 2-y 92.7 vs 75.8%, 3-y 77.6 vs 59.7%; 2–5 cm NS (HR 0.58, p=0.31); PFS and OS identical
39693584.caution: Primary endpoint is a composite counting death from any cause

39699905.label: RTOG 1112
39699905.result: SBRT + sorafenib vs sorafenib: median OS 15.8 vs 12.3 mo; HR 0.77 (90% CI 0.59–1.01), one-sided p=0.06 — primary endpoint missed
39699905.caution: 177 analysed of 368 planned (65% power); obsolete comparator

39716538.label: Bardhi 2025
39716538.result: Adding BiliSeq NGS to cytology and biopsy raised malignant-stricture sensitivity from 42.9% to 85.7%; single centre
39716538.caution: Sensitivity 20% in the five PSC patients with cancer; no hilar subgroup

39789825.label: EUS-FNB AE meta-analysis
39789825.result: 20-22G EUS-FNB: overall adverse events 1.8%; liver 14.0% (95% CI 7.7-24.0%)
39789825.caution: Liver estimate from 4 studies, 133 patients, 18 events

39798578.label: LEAP-012
39798578.result: Median PFS 14.6 vs 10.0 mo, lenvatinib + pembrolizumab + TACE vs TACE; HR 0.66; OS HR 0.80 (0.57–1.11), p=0.087 — missed boundary
39798578.caution: Grade ≥3 treatment-related events 71 vs 32%; trial-specific progression definition

39798579.label: EMERALD-1
39798579.result: Durvalumab+bevacizumab+TACE vs TACE: median PFS 15.0 vs 8.2 mo, HR 0.77; durvalumab+TACE HR 0.94; interim OS not significant
39798579.caution: Primary comparison switched by amendment to bevacizumab arm; OS withheld

39831703.label: Malignancy risk score
39831703.result: Malignancy in 46.4% of resected periampullary adenomas; benign cases had threefold more major complications; 0–6 risk score proposed
39831703.caution: Score derived and tested in the same 127 patients; no validation

39848272.label: COLLISION
39848272.result: Ablation vs resection: OS HR 1.05 (0.69–1.58), crosses 1.30 margin — non-inferiority not shown; AEs 19 vs 46%; stay 1 vs 4 days
39848272.caution: Stopped at 48% of planned 618; about a third of each arm also had the other modality

39864891.label: ESMO BTC 2024 interim
39864891.result: Guideline update: profile at start of first line; add durvalumab or pembrolizumab to gemcitabine-cisplatin; avoid triplets; targeted agents by alteration
39864891.caution: Mostly level III evidence graded A; silent on surgery, adjuvant therapy, staging and LT

39874977.label: CheckMate 8HW
39874977.result: Nivolumab+ipilimumab vs nivolumab (all lines): centrally reviewed PFS HR 0.62 (0.48–0.81); response 71 vs 58%
39874977.caution: First-line comparison failed prespecified boundary at interim; OS withheld

39908431.label: eNRGy zenocutuzumab
39908431.result: NRG1 fusion, KRAS wild-type pancreatic cancer (n=36): investigator-assessed ORR 42%; single-arm
39908431.caution: No survival data for the pancreatic subgroup; no control arm

39936601.label: Terashima 2025
39936601.result: Review of the 2019 WHO definition; argues cHCC-CCA is not yet an independent entity for treatment purposes
39936601.caution: Japanese national data rest on only 39 of 263 confirmed cases

40014003.label: ILTS-ILCA 2024 consensus
40014003.result: Consensus: LT may be considered for cirrhotic iCCA ≤3 cm after a period of stability; larger or non-cirrhotic iCCA only in trials
40014003.caution: iCCA statements graded low/moderate; 3 cm cutoff not derived in any cited study

40037890.label: Tanabe 2025
40037890.result: HCC-directed first-line therapy in cHCC-CCA: response 33.3%, median OS 14.9 mo; lenvatinib response 42.9% (n=14)
40037890.caution: No biliary-regimen comparator; unusually fit, pre-treated cohort

40126570.label: Neoadjuvant meta-analysis
40126570.result: Neoadjuvant vs upfront surgery: HR 0.60 in borderline resectable, 0.90 in resectable PDAC; lower resection rate, twice the serious adverse events
40126570.caution: Subgroup difference not significant; comparator mostly obsolete adjuvant gemcitabine

40302310.label: HEPAR PLuS
40302310.result: Ho-166 SIRT after PRRT vs PRRT alone: 2-y hepatic PFS 82 vs 50%, intrahepatic response 75 vs 29%; median PFS and OS unchanged
40302310.caution: Primary endpoint compared without a statistical test; retrospective chart controls

40349714.label: CheckMate 9DW
40349714.result: Median OS 23.7 vs 20.6 mo, nivolumab + ipilimumab vs lenvatinib/sorafenib; HR 0.79 (0.65–0.96), p=0.018 (interim)
40349714.caution: Curves cross: early mortality HR 1.65 in first 6 months; PFS did not differ

40444708.label: BREAKWATER
40444708.result: First-line encorafenib+cetuximab+mFOLFOX6 vs standard: median OS 30.3 vs 15.1 mo, HR 0.49 (0.375–0.632); PFS 12.8 vs 7.1 mo
40444708.caution: Interim OS; 72% of controls later received a BRAF inhibitor

40478744.label: Milan consensus
40478744.result: Consensus: LT extended to node-negative pCCA regardless of resectability; resectability criteria expert opinion; no staging system endorsed for it
40478744.caution: 84% of 570 studies observational; most surgical recommendations level of evidence 4

40523372.label: MEN1 2025 guideline
40523372.result: Systematic review (37 studies): surgery vs active surveillance for MEN1 NF-PanNET ≤2 cm — no difference in metastasis or mortality
40523372.caution: Low/very low GRADE certainty; caution advised on expert judgement, not data

40554738.label: SURF final
40554738.result: Surgery vs ablation: 5-y OS 74.6 vs 70.4%, HR 0.96, adjusted p=0.84; RFS 42.9 vs 42.7% — failed superiority, not proven equivalence
40554738.caution: 67.2% power for the 10-point difference; local recurrence twice as common after ablation

40603768.label: He 2025 cHCC-CCA vs iCCA
40603768.result: AFP >100 ng/mL discordant with CCA-like MRI raised AUC for cHCC-CCA vs mass-forming iCCA from 0.687 to 0.807

40640089.label: Chinese 2024 consensus
40640089.result: Consensus: liver MRI before any local treatment, universal molecular testing, locoregional therapy after systemic failure
40640089.caution: No consensus method or search described; no FLR, staged hepatectomy or LT criteria

40666526.label: Lin 2025 interventional + IO
40666526.result: Interventional + immunotargeted therapy: median survival 17.8 mo, response 41–57%; 22% downstaged to resection; single-arm
40666526.caution: No control group; heterogeneous regimens; Child-Pugh A only

40670095.label: Sun 2025 adjuvant chemotherapy
40670095.result: Adjuvant chemotherapy after R0 resection of cHCC-CCA associated with better OS, concentrated in a nomogram-defined high-risk group
40670095.caution: Only 19 treated; nomogram AUC 0.69; contradicts same-year SEER analysis

40672084.label: Lu 2025 SEER adjuvant
40672084.result: No survival advantage from postoperative chemotherapy in resected cHCC-CCA (SEER)
40672084.caution: Only 59 treated; sicker treatment arm; no recurrence data

40713471.label: UK NHSBT-LAG 2025
40713471.result: Guideline: benign liver tumour patients assigned to four transplant-eligibility categories by consensus
40713471.caution: Expert opinion only; no cohort data or molecular adenoma risk variables

40729532.label: PERIPAN 2025
40729532.result: Consensus: defines ampullary carcinoma, retires 'periampullary' as a diagnosis, 30% threshold for mixed subtype, reflex MMR testing
40729532.caution: Subtype prognostic value unclear; almost all recommendations low-evidence or expert opinion

40802908.label: CONKO-007
40802908.result: Consolidation CRT vs chemo: R0 25% vs 18% (P=.113); median OS 15 vs 14 mo, HR 0.94 — primary endpoint not met
40802908.caution: Primary endpoint changed mid-trial; surgical comparisons not randomised

40945523.label: PREOPANC-2
40945523.result: Neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX vs gemcitabine-based CRT: median OS 21.9 vs 21.3 mo, HR 0.88, p=0.32 — no OS improvement
40945523.caution: Wide CI does not establish equivalence; no comparison with upfront surgery

41082695.label: PUMP-2
41082695.result: HAI FUDR: median OS 22.3 mo, 3-y OS 31.5%; partial response 44%; 5/50 (10%) resected; single-arm, historical control
41082695.caution: No randomised comparison with modern chemo-immunotherapy

41121221.label: Lu 2025 lymphadenectomy
41121221.result: Undissected patients survived longer, reflecting more favourable (often cHCC-CCA) tumours; adjusted PFS HR 2.12 runs against the title
41121221.caution: Lymphadenectomy driven by preoperative CCA suspicion

41151697.label: BCLC 2026
41151697.result: Guideline: EBRT and radioembolisation enter early stage; microwave preferred to RFA up to 3–4 cm; ECOG 2 and four first-line doublets in BCLC C
41151697.caution: Key thresholds (HVPG, AFP downstaging, TACE-unsuitable) undefined; mostly observational evidence

41192607.label: Japanese 22-centre papillectomy
41192607.result: Histologic R0 in only half despite en bloc resection; recurrence 20% at 3 y overall, 11% after R0 — surveil regardless of margin; retrospective
41192607.caution: Recurrence includes early residual disease; Japanese adenocarcinoma criteria

41264278.label: HERIZON-BTC-01
41264278.result: Zanidatamab, pretreated HER2+ BTC: confirmed ORR 41% (52% IHC 3+); median response duration 14.9 mo; median OS 18.1 mo in 3+; single-arm
41264278.caution: IHC 2+ cohort (n=18) essentially inactive; no results by subsite, iCCA effect unknown

41364225.label: Shen 2026 meta-analysis
41364225.result: Watched adenomas: 88.5% stable or regressing; symptomatic bleeding 0.5%; malignant transformation 0.8%
41364225.caution: Informative censoring by intervention; not all adenomas over 5 cm

41399117.label: KOTRY registry
41399117.result: Incidental cHCC-CC at LT: 3-y OS 59.3%, RFS 50.2%; no preoperative criterion predicted outcome; registry

41528222.label: MALRIC recurrent
41528222.result: Recurrent iCCA, MWA vs repeat hepatectomy: OS statistically indistinguishable, median 4 mo shorter with MWA; a sixth of major complications; observational
41528222.caution: Not equivalence; DFS upper bound at 1.00; authors call results exploratory

41564818.label: Gerdes 2026 genomic cohort
41564818.result: cHCC-CCA: IDH1 8.0% and FGFR2 7.3% alterations (absent in HCC), 34.7% potentially actionable; HCC histology upheld in 41% of genomically suspicious cases

41580093.label: IMbrave050 update
41580093.result: Final: median RFS 33.2 vs 36.0 mo, atezolizumab-bevacizumab vs surveillance; HR 0.90 (0.72–1.12); OS HR 1.26 (0.85–1.87)
41580093.caution: Descriptive analysis; 30% of surveillance arm crossed over

41639545.label: Lee 2026 surgical review
41639545.result: Review of iCCA resection technique: 25-40% 5-y OS after R0 resection, >60% recurrence; applied to cHCC-CCA by analogy

41680345.label: Nonoperative management review
41680345.result: Review: subtype-matched medical therapy agenda for HCA (GLP-1 agonists, JAK/STAT inhibitors, GLI1 antagonists); no clinical data
41680345.caution: Establishes what might be tested, nothing currently offerable

41685088.label: Kodali 2026 matched cohort
41685088.result: Incidental cHCC-CCA vs matched HCC after LT: 4.7- to 6.5-fold mortality hazard; within Milan 84.2% on imaging vs 36.8% on explant

41781152.label: Hong 2026 systemic review
41781152.result: Review: gemcitabine-platinum 10–16 mo; checkpoint inhibitor response 20–33%; 57% immune-high, 25% actionable
41781152.caution: Proposed molecular treatment algorithm is unvalidated

41781153.label: Lee 2026 transplant overview
41781153.result: Review: no society endorses LT for cHCC-CCA; almost all reported transplants lacked a preoperative diagnosis, so favourable-case selection is unproven

41905432.label: Biliary-stricture NGS
41905432.result: NGS vs pathology: sensitivity 82% vs 44%, specificity 98% vs 99%; combined sensitivity 88%; intrahepatic/hilar 80% vs 36%
41905432.caution: Not head-to-head: tests on different specimens; submission at endoscopist discretion

41990853.label: ESMO 2026
41990853.result: Guideline: LT for highly selected permanently unresectable liver-only disease [II, A]; thermal ablation over resection for lesions <3 cm [II, B]
41990853.caution: Expert-opinion, non-systematic; LT criteria looser than IHPBA consensus

42049568.label: Sierra 2026 UNOS
42049568.result: cHCC-CCA candidates: lowest 3-y dropout (29.0%) and waitlist mortality, but worst post-LT survival (adjusted mortality HR 1.67)
42049568.caution: 89.9% transplanted under a pre-transplant HCC diagnosis

42068695.label: Kimura 2026 meta-analysis
42068695.result: LT vs resection for cHCC-CCA: better 5-y survival (OR 0.55) and RFS (OR 0.40); six retrospective studies
42068695.caution: Tumour sizes differ twofold; one matched study; not robust to leave-one-out

42090791.label: Daraxonrasib phase 1–2
42090791.result: Tolerable at 300 mg: treatment-related grade 3+ toxicity 30%; ORR 35% in 26-patient post hoc subgroup
42090791.caution: Primary purpose safety; response from post hoc subgroup

42191146.label: PSVD/NCPF consensus 2026
42191146.result: Consensus: PSVD/NCPF unified; biopsy mandatory (adequacy 15 mm, 10 mm fragment); NRH, muscularised venules, venule stenosis in ≥50% tracts major criteria
42191146.caution: Score fitted to expert votes on 36 hypothetical scenarios; diagnostic validity not shown

42214026.label: Florou 2026
42214026.result: 76.2% managed by surveillance; rupture 1.8%; no malignant transformation under surveillance; every HCC in a lesion >5 cm and of high-risk subtype
42214026.caution: Only six HCC events; cannot separate size from subtype

42223072.label: RASolute 302
42223072.result: Daraxonrasib vs chemotherapy (RAS G12): median OS 13.2 vs 6.6 mo, HR 0.40; no benefit in non-G12 subgroup
42223072.caution: Control arm: 15.1% never got allocated chemotherapy, 11.2% stopped for toxicity

42312290.label: ILTS-ILCA 2024 consensus
42312290.result: Consensus: cirrhotic iCCA ≤3 cm with observed stability may be transplanted; non-cirrhotic or locally advanced only in protocols
42312290.caution: Second publication of same 54 recommendations; iCCA statements low/moderate grade

42331230.label: Pooled HAI pump iCCA IPD
42331230.result: HAI pump for unresectable iCCA, pooled four phase II trials: median OS 26 mo, 5-y OS 15%

42409696.label: Wang 2026 component proportion
42409696.result: >70% HCC component associated with longer RFS and OS, more intrahepatic recurrence, and the only signal of benefit from adjuvant TACE
42409696.caution: Unvalidated threshold, measurable only after resection

42413329.label: Hsu 2026 durvalumab plus GemCis
42413329.result: Durvalumab+GemCis, cHCC-CCA vs cholangiocarcinoma: survival 13.8 vs 13.3 mo, similar toxicity; retrospective
42413329.caution: Only 21 cHCC-CCA; CI spans 2.1 to 25.6 months — underpowered null

42572136.label: SECA-II 10-year
42572136.result: LT for unresectable CRLM: median OS 128.2 mo; 5-y OS 77.8%, 10-y 51.5%; median RFS 24.3 mo; single-arm
42572136.caution: Stringent selection (CEA <33, all lesions <5.5 cm); 48% relapsed within two years

42636832.label: EMERALD-3
42636832.result: STRIDE+lenvatinib+TACE vs TACE: PFS 13.0 vs 9.8 mo; OS HR 0.84 (0.65–1.09), p=0.18 — not improved
42636832.caution: OS at 40% maturity; grade 3–4 treatment-related events 63 vs 19%

42678415.label: WHO 6th ed., as reviewed
42678415.result: Review of WHO position: subtype-guided HCA care; exon 3 β-catenin HCA resected regardless of size; sonic hedgehog HCA bleed below 5 cm
42678415.caution: Narrative review, no new data; subtype markers insensitive, non-specific or need sequencing

42692059.label: ESGE 2026
42692059.result: Guideline: endoscopic ahead of percutaneous drainage for malignant hilar obstruction; drain >50%, ideally ≥70%, of viable liver volume
42692059.caution: Preoperative preference rests on one terminated 54-patient trial with negative primary endpoint

42698384.label: Gillmeister 2026
42698384.result: Gene sequencing of ERCP biopsies: sensitivity 65% vs 52% histopathology alone, 78% combined; specificity around 96%
42698384.caution: No CIs or limit-of-detection validation; no stricture identified as perihilar

42743010.label: Abscess drainage meta-analysis
42743010.result: Catheter drainage vs needle aspiration: treatment success OR 4.12 (2.01–8.45); complications OR 1.02 (0.30–3.50)
42743010.caution: Mostly Indian, amoebic-predominant trials; 'treatment success' undefined
